abstract: The increasing electoral success of populist radical‐right parties poses a significant challenge to established political parties in Western democracies. While mainstream parties often maintain a policy of non‐cooperation with these newcomers, such cordon sanitaire strategies can become increasingly costly as radical parties gain support. This study examines the conditions under which established parties abandon their exclusionary stance, focusing on the case of the Sweden Democrats in Swedish municipal politics. We adapt time series econometric methods to identify unknown thresholds at which exclusion costs become untenable, leading to shifts in coalition formation strategies. Our analysis reveals a critical threshold at approximately 18.5% electoral support, beyond which the probability of Sweden Democrats' inclusion in governing coalitions significantly increases. We demonstrate that as radical party support approaches this threshold, coalition sizes expand, office rents are redistributed, and the ideological dispersion of governing parties widens. Once the threshold is surpassed, these trends reverse. Our findings highlight the trade‐offs faced by mainstream parties in responding to the rise of challenger parties, and contribute to broader debates on coalition formation, party system change, and the accommodation of anti‐establishment parties in democratic systems.
title: Between Scylla and Charybdis: the trade‐offs of coalition formation under radical‐right pressure

abstract: This article traces the evolution of the Economic History Review over its first century and places it within the broader transformation of economic history as a discipline. Drawing on a new database covering 2761 articles published in the journal between 1927 and 2025 by 2011 authors from 571 institutions in 50 countries, it analyses changes in editorial leadership, research topics, historical periods, geographical coverage, methods, authorship, and citation patterns. The findings suggest that the journal evolved from a predominantly UK outlet into one of the leading international journals in economic history. Over time, it converged towards the model of the major international field journals, with citation networks revealing a shift from stronger links with history to closer connections with economics. At the same time, however, the journal retained a distinctive profile, preserving a more historical orientation than the leading American journals. The article also documents a marked process of internationalization, reflected in both the geographical scope of published research and the growing presence of scholars from continental Europe. Finally, citation analysis shows that articles addressing long‐run and geographically comparative questions achieve the highest scholarly impact.
title:
The old lady of economic history: 100 years of the

abstract: Ecological buffer zones are institutionalised as critical instruments for mediating the urban-ecological interface, yet their empirical performance under rapid urbanisation remains unclear, particularly in Sub-Saharan Africa. This study examines the spatial dynamics and regulatory effectiveness of ecological buffer zones in the Weija Lake Area, Ghana, a peri-urban reservoir under sustained pressure from metropolitan expansion. Integrating multi-temporal land use and land cover analysis, institutional assessment and community survey methods, the study finds that the Weija Lake buffer has lost nearly 8% of its ecological area. In comparison, over 66% of the adjacent Densu Delta Ramsar Site has been converted to urban use. Encroachment is driven by the convergence of land affordability, housing deficits, and customary tenure dynamics, compounded by governance fragmentation across overlapping statutory and traditional authorities, normalised non-compliance and livelihood-embedded resource exploitation. Residents generally assign responsibility for protecting ecological buffer zones to government agencies, traditional authorities and community leaders rather than viewing stewardship as a shared personal responsibility. Their willingness and capacity to comply with buffer-zone restrictions are also shaped by their livelihood circumstances and the perceived security and legitimacy of their land claims, particularly where occupation of land is linked to inherited tenure. Legal designation alone does not guarantee ecological protection; its effectiveness is contingent on institutional coordination, enforcement capacity and community legitimacy. By advancing a boundary-specific, integrated framework for buffer zone evaluation, this study provides actionable evidence for adaptive co-management and livelihood-sensitive enforcement strategies vital to urban water security and long-term ecological resilience in Ghana.
abstract_zh: 生态缓冲区作为一种制度化工具，被视为调节城市—生态界面的关键手段，但其在快速城市化背景下的实际绩效仍不明确，在撒哈拉以南非洲尤为如此。本研究考察加纳韦贾湖区的生态缓冲区空间动态与监管有效性；该湖区是持续承受大都市扩张压力的城郊水库。研究整合多时相土地利用与土地覆盖分析、制度评估和社区调查方法，发现韦贾湖缓冲带已丧失近8%的生态面积，而相邻的登苏三角洲拉姆萨尔湿地已有超过66%被转为城市用途。侵占由土地可负担性、住房短缺和习惯法权属动态共同驱动，并因重叠的法定与传统权威之间的治理碎片化、常态化不遵守以及嵌入生计的资源开发而加剧。居民普遍将保护生态缓冲区的责任归于政府机构、传统权威和社区领袖，而非将管护视为个人共同责任。其遵守缓冲区限制的意愿和能力还受生计状况及其土地权属主张所感知的安全性与合法性影响，尤其是在土地占用与继承权属相关的情形下。仅靠法律指定并不能保证生态保护；其有效性取决于制度协调、执法能力和社区合法性。通过提出一种针对边界、整合性的缓冲区评估框架，本研究为适应性协同管理和对生计敏感的执法策略提供了可操作证据，这些策略对加纳的城市水安全和长期生态韧性至关重要。
title: Urban land use change, tenure complexity, and the limits of ecological buffer zone regulation in urban Ghana

abstract: This paper provides a structural analysis of the role of job vacancy referrals (VRs) by public employment agencies in the job search behavior of unemployed individuals, incorporating institutional features of the monitoring of search behavior by the agencies. Notably, rejections of VRs may lead to sanctions (temporary benefits reductions) while workers may report sick to avoid those. We estimate models using German administrative data from social security records linked with caseworker recorded data on VRs, sick reporting and sanctions. The analysis highlights the influence of aspects of the health care system on unemployment durations. We estimate that for around 25% of unemployed workers, removing the channel that enables strategic sick reporting reduces the mean unemployment duration by 4 days.
title: Structural Empirical Analysis of Vacancy Referrals with Imperfect Monitoring and the Strategic Use of Sickness Absence

abstract: This paper documents a robust link between COVID-19 lockdowns and the uptake and persistence of working from home (WFH) practices. Exploiting rich longitudinal data, we use a difference-in-differences strategy to compare office workers in three heavily locked-down Australian states to similar workers in less affected states. Locked-down workers sustain 43% higher WFH levels through 2023  0.5 days per week  with a monotonic doseresponse relationship. Persistence is driven by adjustments on both sides of the labor market: employers downsize office space and open remote/hybrid positions, while employees relocate away from city centers and invest in home offices and technology.
title: A new equilibrium: COVID-19 lockdowns and WFH persistence

abstract: Rewarding teachers on the basis of student performance is a growing trend in educational policy. This paper estimates the effects of a policy that ties payments with teachers’ pedagogical skills instead. We study a large-scale reform in Chile that introduced financial incentives tied to a teacher evaluation system. Using a unique administrative data set of over 500, 000 student-teacher-year matches, we estimate the effect of the policy on student performance exploiting the program’s gradual roll-out through a differences-in-differences analysis. We document precise, null effects of the policy on student math and language standardized test scores. Estimating a structural model of teacher skills and student performance, we show that by making incentives more homogeneous across the distribution of teacher characteristics policymakers can improve the policy’s effects on student performance and overall welfare.
title: Getting Teachers Back to Study: Input-Based Teacher Incentives and Student Achievement

abstract: Gender differences in preferences for parental leave contribute to the early-career growth in the gender wage gap among highly educated millennial Americans. Estimating a hedonic job-search model, I show that, while both men and women experience wage growth by entering firms offering better pay and benefits, the wage gap increases as women accept lower wages upon receiving job offers from employers providing parental leave. The wage-gap growth could decline by 60% if preferences for paid parental leave did not differ by gender. It could also decline if mandating and subsidizing the provision of paid leave muted workers’ leave-wage trade-off.
title: The Search for Parental Leave and the Early-Career Gender Wage Gap

abstract: Resource-rich developing economies are once again intensifying policy intervention in their mineral sectors. Such policies, aimed at strengthening state control over resources and capturing resource rent, are collectively referred to as resource nationalism. However, their economic consequences remain empirically contested. Drawing on a multi-country database of resource policy events spanning 2000–2023, we identify three categories of high-intensity interventions and assess their effects on economic growth and household welfare, including export controls, heavy taxation, and nationalization/state equity participation. We further examine transmission mechanisms and sources of heterogeneity. The results indicate that the economic effects of resource nationalism are highly conditional. The effect depends on policy type, implementation intensity, and the fit between policy design and national governance. Countries with stronger governance capacity are more likely to translate resource control into productive expansion and economic gains. In contrast, in weakly governed or highly resource-dependent lower-middle-income countries, benefits are largely confined to fiscal and distributional channels rather than sustained output growth. Mechanism analysis shows that different policy instruments generate significant but heterogeneous adjustments through channels including fiscal revenues, trade structures, and sectoral output. Yet these changes do not systematically translate into sustained macroeconomic expansion. Sequential analysis reveals that repeated implementation of the same policy type follows a nonlinear path of diminishing marginal returns. Even in high-governance countries, repeated interventions fail to sustain stable growth dividends. These findings suggest that resource nationalism is a policy instrument highly contingent on institutional conditions with governance capacity and industrial absorptive capacity serving as prerequisites for policy effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 资源型发展中经济体正再次加强对矿产部门的政策干预。此类旨在强化国家对资源的控制并获取资源租金的政策被统称为资源民族主义。然而，其经济后果在实证上仍存在争议。基于涵盖2000—2023年资源政策事件的多国数据库，我们识别出三类高强度干预措施，并评估其对经济增长和家庭福利的影响，包括出口管制、重税以及国有化/国家股权参与。我们进一步考察传导机制和异质性来源。结果表明，资源民族主义的经济效应具有高度条件性。其效应取决于政策类型、实施强度以及政策设计与国家治理的匹配程度。治理能力较强的国家更可能将资源控制转化为生产性扩张和经济收益。相比之下，在治理薄弱或资源依赖度较高的中低收入国家，收益主要局限于财政和分配渠道，而非持续的产出增长。机制分析表明，不同政策工具通过财政收入、贸易结构和部门产出等渠道产生显著但异质的调整。然而，这些变化并未系统性地转化为持续的宏观经济扩张。序贯分析揭示，同一政策类型的反复实施遵循边际回报递减的非线性路径。即使在治理水平较高的国家，反复干预也未能维持稳定的增长红利。这些发现表明，资源民族主义是一种高度依赖制度条件的政策工具，治理能力和产业吸收能力是政策有效性的前提条件。
title: Resource nationalism and economic outcomes: evidence from national policy interventions
title_zh: 资源民族主义与经济结果：来自国家政策干预的证据

abstract: Early-life food deprivation (EFD) may shape rural household livelihoods and welfare decades later, yet its implications for household factor allocation and livelihood strategies remain insufficiently understood. Using the 2010 China Family Panel Studies and exploiting variation in famine severity across birth cohorts and provinces, this study applies a cohort difference-in-differences strategy to examine the long-term effects of household heads’ early-life famine exposure for rural households. Households whose heads experienced more severe EFD exhibit a more agriculture-dependent and less diversified livelihood strategy. They are more likely to rent in land, less likely to rent it out, borrow less, and participate less in non-farm employment and non-farm business activities. The individual-level results provide suggestive evidence of psychological scarring: more severely exposed household heads exhibit greater depressive symptoms and weaker confidence in future prospects. Evidence of human-capital impairment is limited to lower educational attainment, with no consistent significant differences in observed later-life physical health. The welfare estimates show lower total and non-farm income, lower total and non-food consumption, and higher farm-income shares and Engel coefficient. Cohort-specific analyses show a broader pattern of statistically significant associations for childhood or adolescent exposure, including greater land rent-in, lower borrowing and non-farm participation, and lower income and consumption. For prenatal or infant exposure, significant associations are concentrated in lower non-farm employment and income. These findings highlight the need to safeguard early-life development beyond restoring food availability and to improve agricultural returns while expanding access to non-farm opportunities.
abstract_zh: 早期食物剥夺（EFD）可能在此后数十年间塑造农村家庭的生计与福利，但其对家庭要素配置和生计策略的影响仍缺乏充分认识。本研究使用2010年中国家庭追踪调查数据，利用出生队列与省份之间饥荒严重程度的差异，采用队列双重差分策略，考察户主早年饥荒暴露对农村家庭的长期影响。户主经历更严重EFD的家庭表现出更依赖农业、多样化程度更低的生计策略。他们更可能租入土地，更不可能租出土地，借贷更少，参与非农就业和非农经营活动的程度更低。个体层面结果为心理创伤提供了提示性证据：暴露更严重的户主表现出更严重的抑郁症状和对未来前景更弱的信心。人力资本受损的证据仅限于受教育程度较低，而观察到的晚年身体健康没有一致显著差异。福利估计显示总收入和非农收入更低、总消费和非食品消费更低、农业收入份额和恩格尔系数更高。分队列分析显示，儿童期或青少年期暴露具有更广泛且统计显著的关联模式，包括更多租入土地、更少借贷和非农参与，以及更低收入和消费。对于产前或婴儿期暴露，显著关联集中在非农就业和非农收入更低。这些发现凸显了在恢复食物可获得性之外保障早期发展的必要性，以及提高农业回报同时扩大非农机会可及性的必要性。

abstract: In this study, we examine the extent to which individuals’ views on key root causes of inequality align with empirical evidence. Specifically, we compare perceptions of the relative importance of various determinants of success with objective estimates of how education, hours worked, family background, and gender influence income inequality across 27 European countries. We find little correlation between perceptions and reality. While individuals tend to more accurately recognize the role of education, the importance of family background and gender is more strongly perceived among those directly affected by these factors. For instance, women exhibit greater awareness of gender-based disparities, and individuals having experienced disadvantaged economic conditions in the past hold perceptions more closely aligned with the observed impact of family background. In contrast, those who are employed, upwardly mobile, or financially secure are more likely to attribute outcomes to hard work. These distorted perceptions, in turn, shape attitudes toward redistribution: beliefs about the importance of hard work and the perceived level of inequality of opportunity emerge as key predictors of support for redistributive policies.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们考察个体对不平等关键根源的看法与经验证据的一致程度。具体而言，我们将人们对成功各决定因素相对重要性的认知，与教育、工作时长、家庭背景和性别如何影响27个欧洲国家收入不平等的客观估计进行比较。我们发现认知与现实之间几乎没有相关性。尽管个体往往能更准确地认识到教育的作用，但家庭背景和性别的重要性在直接受这些因素影响的人群中被更强烈地感知。例如，女性对基于性别的差距表现出更强的意识，而过去经历过不利经济状况的个体，其认知与观察到的家庭背景影响更为一致。相比之下，就业者、向上流动者或经济状况有保障者更可能将结果归因于努力工作。这些扭曲的认知反过来塑造了对再分配的态度：关于努力工作重要性的信念和对机会不平等程度的感知，成为支持再分配政策的关键预测因素。

abstract: Can contemporary female HIV rates be traced back to women's position in ancestral societies? In matrilineal kinship organizations, lineage and inheritance are traced through female members, granting women historically greater agency while reducing the structural stability of the marital bond. This paper tests the hypothesis that ancestral matrilineality, by shaping women's sexual and contraceptive behaviors, significantly impacts the prevalence of female HIV today. By exploiting individual-level variation in ethnic identity across 18 countries, and using granular region-survey fixed effects, I find that women from ancestrally matrilineal ethnic groups face a significantly higher probability of being HIV-positive. This \enquote{matrilineal penalty} is confirmed by a geographic regression discontinuity design (RDD) at ethnic boundaries, ensuring the results reflect persistent social structures rather than geographic confounders. I identify three primary behavioral mechanisms: (i) increased female agency leading to greater sexual mobility and marital turnover; (ii) a coordination failure within the couple regarding condom use due to the fragility of the marital bond; and (iii) biological evidence from couple sero-discordance showing that the virus primarily enters the household through the female partner. These results suggest that female agency, in the absence of formal diagnostic information, may increase vulnerability to health shocks. My findings call for public health policies that prioritize routine HIV testing to bridge the information gap and convert latent ancestral agency into active health protection.
title: Women’s Position in Ancestral Societies and Female HIV: The Long-Term Effect of Matrilineality in Sub-Saharan Africa

abstract: The (post)pandemic period was marked by numerous port disruptions, leading to delays and rising costs for shippers. We build a fluid model in transient states to investigate how a disruption at one port can affect the disrupted port and its counterpart in another country in a circulatory container shipping system, where a stream of fleets moves goods back and forth between the two ports. Port disruption leads to two types of congestion: the inbound backlogs, which occur when ships are unable to enter the port, and the outbound backlogs, which arise when goods are unable to be loaded onto ships for transport to other ports. We analytically characterize the system’s recovery time, measured from the onset of the port closure until normal operations are restored, and the dynamics of inbound and outbound backlogs during recovery. We identify a whiplash effect in which outbound backlogs alternate between ports, creating oscillatory congestion patterns because of the disruption-induced uneven spatial distribution of ships. Our analysis reveals that simply increasing ship capacity may not expedite system recovery, highlighting the importance of coordination between port authorities and shipping companies when jointly planning capacity expansions. Furthermore, we examine several extensions of the model. We use the two-port system as a building block to analyze bipartite and cyclic network structures, and we also consider scenarios in which a port experiences multiple disruptions. In all cases, the whiplash effect persists, thereby demonstrating the robustness of our findings. Finally, we use our theory model prediction as a feature and apply machine learning techniques to predict the time that vessels spend in Shanghai Port after a typhoon disruption and show that using our model predictor, alongside all relevant vessel and voyage attributes as raw features, significantly reduces prediction errors by 10%–30% on average compared with not using it. This paper was accepted by Elena Katok, operations management. Funding: This work was supported by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada [Grant RGPIN-2021-04295]. abstract_zh: （后）疫情时期以频繁的港口中断为特征，导致托运人延误和成本上升。我们构建了一个瞬态下的流体模型，以研究在循环集装箱航运系统中，一个港口的中断如何影响被中断港口及其位于另一国家的对应港口，其中一系列船队在两个港口之间往返运输货物。港口中断导致两类拥堵：入港积压，即船舶无法进入港口时发生；出港积压，即货物无法装载到船上运往其他港口时产生。我们解析刻画了系统的恢复时间（从港口关闭开始至恢复正常运营为止）以及恢复期间入港和出港积压的动态。我们识别出一种鞭尾效应，即出港积压在港口之间交替，由于中断导致的船舶空间分布不均而形成振荡性拥堵模式。我们的分析表明，单纯增加船舶容量可能不会加快系统恢复，凸显了港口当局与航运公司在联合规划容量扩张时协调的重要性。此外，我们考察了模型的若干扩展。我们以两港系统作为构建模块来分析二分和循环网络结构，并且还考虑了港口经历多次中断的情景。在所有情况下，鞭尾效应持续存在，从而证明了我们发现结果的稳健性。最后，我们将理论模型预测作为一个特征，应用机器学习技术来预测台风中断后船舶在上海港的停留时间，并表明使用我们的模型预测器，连同所有相关船舶和航次属性作为原始特征，与不使用它相比，平均显著降低预测误差10%–30%。本文被Elena Katok，运营管理接受。资助：本工作得到加拿大自然科学与工程研究理事会[资助号RGPIN-2021-04295]的支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.05427获取。

abstract: We show that a biodiversity risk premium has emerged in the U.S. corporate bond market following the United Nations Biodiversity Conference (COP15) in October 2021. COP15 placed biodiversity on the global regulatory agenda and raised transition risks for exposed firms. After COP15, a one standard deviation increase in a firm’s biodiversity footprint is associated with a 7% increase in its secondary market yield spreads, whereas this relation is insignificant before COP15. The biodiversity effect is also present in primary bond markets, most pronounced for medium-term bonds and distinct from climate-related mechanisms. Furthermore, a higher biodiversity footprint is associated with a lower likelihood of issuing medium-term bonds after COP15, consistent with firms managing their biodiversity-related risks. Evidence from firms’ biodiversity dependencies suggests that physical biodiversity risks are also priced in the bond market. This paper was accepted by Bo Becker, finance. abstract: The rise of social media platforms has enabled customers to rely on influencers and peer reviews to guide their purchasing decisions. As products increasingly focus on experiences, firms are leveraging influencer marketing as a crucial tool. This paper addresses key challenges of influencer marketing by considering different types of influencers and partnership schemes alongside the impact of social learning. We introduce a two-period model wherein, in the initial period, the firm unveils a new product experience of unknown quality alongside an influencer marketing campaign. The campaign relies on two types of influencers that differ in popularity and engagement levels and two partnerships: sponsored advertising and public relations. Customers base their purchasing decisions on their original (heterogeneous) beliefs, influencer-driven information, and reviews from early adopters in the second period. When customers are equally likely to follow any given influencer, the firm should choose a single influencer type and partnership. Consumer reviews complement influencer marketing when products are initially undervalued, increasing the returns to influencer investment. Moreover, within a societal structure characterized by distinct classes, in which followers and influencers often belong to the same class, a mix of influencer types and partnership schemes may become optimal. Our study provides guidance on selecting influencer types, partnership schemes, and social media platforms based on engagement, popularity, audience composition, and platform characteristics. This paper was accepted by Jeanette Song, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07919 .

abstract: We investigate the effects of mutual funds’ commitments to responsible investing on their information acquisition activities and the corresponding externalities for other stakeholders. After committing to responsible investing (via United Nations Principles for Responsible Investment (UNPRI)), fund managers increase private information acquisition activities, that is, corporate site visits, particularly focusing on environmental and social issues. These visits generate negligible private investment value for the visiting funds. However, the information environment at the stock level improves following these visits with lower consensus analyst forecast errors. In addition to the information production role of these visits, they also generate positive externalities for other stakeholders through incremental improvements in the sustainability practices of the firms receiving sustainability-focused site visits from UNPRI fund managers. abstract: Land reforms are often assumed to promote economic development in unequal societies. However, supportive cross-country evidence remains limited, largely because major land reforms are rare events that provide insufficient identifying variation in small samples. Drawing on a global dataset of major land reforms over the period 1820–2010, we provide evidence that pro-poor land reforms promote economic development by increasing school enrollment and reducing fertility, whereas non-pro-poor land reforms do not. We further show that these empirical patterns are consistent with the relaxation of credit constraints among poor households and the weakening of the political power of the landed elites, which together facilitate greater human capital investment and demographic transition. Event-study analyses, semi-parametric difference-in-differences estimations, two-way fixed effects, instrumental variable estimates, and placebo tests collectively suggest that the results are not driven by endogeneity.
abstract_zh: 土地改革常被认为能在不平等社会中促进经济发展。然而，支持性的跨国证据仍然有限，主要因为重大土地改革属于罕见事件，在小样本中提供的识别变异不足。基于1820—2010年间全球重大土地改革数据集，我们提供证据表明，扶助穷人的土地改革通过提高入学率和降低生育率促进经济发展，而非扶助穷人的土地改革则不会产生这种效果。我们进一步表明，这些经验模式与贫困家庭信贷约束的放松以及地主精英政治权力的削弱相一致，二者共同促进了更大的人力资本投资和人口转变。事件研究分析、半参数双重差分估计、双向固定效应、工具变量估计和安慰剂检验共同表明，结果并非由内生性驱动。

abstract: The EU Taxonomy Regulation requires large European non-financial companies to disclose the share of their revenues, capital expenditure (CAPEX), and operating expenditure (OPEX) that are eligible and aligned with six environmental objectives. Using 2023 disclosures from 211 publicly listed companies across 19 countries and 8 industries, this study provides one of the first broad empirical analyses of the eligibility–alignment gap at the firm level. Mean CAPEX eligibility stands at 41.3% against alignment of 15.1%, a gap of 26.2 percentage points equivalent to a EUR 164 billion annual conversion shortfall in the sample. Alignment rates are strongly right-skewed: the majority of companies report negligible aligned activities, while aggregate statistics are driven by Utilities and Energy sector outliers. Building on five hypotheses grounded in the energy economics literature, the study identifies technology readiness, capital intensity, regulatory incentive gradients, industrial structure, and value chain complexity as the primary mechanisms explaining the observed gap. Climate Change Mitigation accounts for virtually all aligned CAPEX, with a ratio of 170:1 over all other Taxonomy objectives combined — consistent with the EU ETS providing direct financial incentives absent for biodiversity, water, and circular economy objectives. A bivariate OLS regression using a country-level Industrial Structure Index explains 25.2% of cross-country CAPEX alignment variance (β = 0.7905, p = 0.028). The results carry implications for the ongoing Omnibus reform process, green finance instrument design, and the future development of non-CCM Taxonomy incentive architecture.

abstract: This study provides new empirical insights into the association between within-country urban-rural energy inequality and deforestation in developing countries. While deforestation is frequently attributed to agricultural expansion and resource extraction, its connection with urban-rural disparities in modern energy access remains largely unexplored. By constructing a composite measure of energy inequality using the Theil index, based on access to electricity and clean cooking fuels, this study examines its statistical association with deforestation across 69 developing countries from 1991 to 2022. We use heterogeneous panel data estimators, with a focus on explicitly accounting for unobserved common factors, non-stationarity, and cointegrated relationships. The results reveal a positive and statistically significant relationship between urban-rural energy inequality and deforestation, suggesting that disparities in access to modern energy are associated with increased reliance on forest-based resources, thereby increasing pressure on forests. Extensive robustness checks support these findings. The heterogeneity analysis further shows that the relationship is statistically significant in Africa, particularly strong in countries with high conflict intensity, and also statistically significant in countries with high ethnic diversity.
title: Energy inequality and deforestation in developing countries

abstract: Addressing regional inequalities in air pollution is crucial for countries like Ukraine, which are undergoing complex transformations in their energy and economic sectors. This study constructs a Latent Regional Greenhouse Gas Emissions Index from stationary energy sources using a Multiple Indicators and Multiple Causes (MIMIC) model. Drawing on a panel of 100 observations across Ukrainian regions (2017–2020), the analysis incorporates both structural drivers (e.g., gross regional product, thermal power output) and observable indicators (e.g., the installed capacities of thermal power plants and combined heat and power plants, together with their electricity generation levels). To ensure model validity, all variables underwent Box–Cox transformation, normalisation, and multicollinearity checks, and subsequent estimation was conducted in R using the lavaan package. The principal six-predictor MIMIC model demonstrates favourable comparative and residual fit (CFI = 0.955; TLI = 0.922; SRMR = 0.029), although the elevated RMSEA indicates limitations in global model fit. Manufacturing output (β = 1.387) and energy-supply output (β = 0.431) exhibit positive associations with the latent index, whereas gross regional product shows a negative association (β = −1.033). However, robustness analyses confirm statistical significance only for manufacturing output and gross regional product, while the significance of energy-supply output is sensitive to the estimation method. Electricity generation by thermal and heat power plants exhibits the highest standardised factor loading (0.974), indicating its strong association with the latent construct. Spatial analysis identifies Donetsk, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia and Ivano-Frankivsk among the regions with the highest estimated relative environmental pressure, with Donetsk reaching the maximum normalised index value of 1.000 in 2018. The proposed approach offers a potentially transferable framework for assessing latent regional energy-related environmental pressures and informing differentiated decarbonisation policies, subject to further model validation.
title: A latent regional greenhouse gas emissions index for Ukraine's energy sector: Insights from a MIMIC model

abstract: Despite rapid economic development, income inequality remains a major development challenge worldwide. Understanding how digitalization shapes income distribution has become increasingly important in the digital era. This study constructs a comprehensive city-level digitalization index for the People’s Republic of China and examines its effect on household income inequality using micro-level survey data. A one-unit increase in a city’s digitalization index reduces household income inequality by 1.83%, an effect confirmed to be causal. This mitigating effect is more pronounced in less-developed regions and among households with lower educational attainment. Mechanism analysis indicates that digitalization narrows inequality by disproportionately raising lower-income households’ earnings through enhanced employment and investment opportunities. Furthermore, digitalization increases business income for entrepreneurial households, particularly those with less education. These findings demonstrate that developing economies can mitigate income inequality by accelerating digital adoption among disadvantaged groups, fostering digital job creation, and improving digital financial literacy.

abstract: This study examines how framed naming influences consumer preferences for cell‐cultured meat alternatives in the United States, China and South Korea, using ground (minced) beef as a case study. Drawing on categorisation and framing theories, we propose that naming provides category cues and framing provides contextual cues, jointly shaping acceptance through perceived category fit. Using choice experiments and scaled random mixed logit models, we estimate willingness‐to‐pay under two framed naming treatments: one distancing cell‐cultured meat alternatives from the beef category (‘lab‐grown product derived from beef cells’) and the other affirming membership in the beef category (‘cell‐cultured ground beef’). The category‐affirming treatment increases mean willingness‐to‐pay by $10.20 per pound in China and $4.20 per pound in the United States but produces no significant increase in South Korea. Market share simulations further show the largest increase for cell‐cultured meat alternatives in China, limited effects in South Korea and a demand shift in the United States primarily from plant‐based alternatives rather than conventional beef. These patterns suggest that country‐specific understandings of beef may condition the extent to which naming and framing cues shape perceived category fit and consumer acceptance, potentially reflecting differences in production traditions and regulatory contexts.

abstract: The simulation of a model with rational expectations requires the solution of a system of difference equations with initial and terminal conditions over an infinite time period. This paper first considers the linear case and investigates the kind of errors which result from the substitution of a finite horizon to the infinite one. The results which are found are applied to the evaluation of the various methods of choice of this horizon and the terminal conditions which are related to it, when the model is nonlinear. Then the paper gives a short review of the methods of simulation which are currently used in macroeconomics. Finally it presents a method of relaxation which has not been used yet in economics: this method rests upon the algorithm of Newton–Raphson and the triangulation of a large matrix by Gauss’ elimination.

abstract: Digitalization can disrupt production before complementary organizational changes begin to pay off. Using panel data on 30 Chinese provincial-level units for 2013–2024, we estimate a first-difference distributed-lag model with year fixed effects and province-clustered inference. Growth in the Digital Economy Index (DEI) is associated with an immediate decline in industrial labour productivity and a substantial but incomplete offset one year later. The immediate decline recurs across alternative lag lengths, polynomial and autoregressive distributed lags, local projections and controls for differential provincial trends; the offset is clearest when lag weights are unrestricted, and the data reject the smoothness restrictions that weaken it. Coefficients beyond the first lag are unstable. The cumulative association is negative through the second lag and imprecise thereafter, and no specification yields a significantly positive cumulative effect within the observed horizon. A one-standard-deviation rise in annual DEI growth is associated with an immediate productivity loss of about 1.1%, roughly one-fifth of average annual productivity growth. The evidence describes an early adjustment-cost phase rather than a completed productivity J-curve. The larger per-unit association in initially less digitalized provinces reflects diminishing returns to the level of the index. Instrumental-variable, procurement and innovation-participation estimates are reported as supplementary associations.

abstract: DSGE models are typically estimated on a small set of observables despite much richer available data. We propose an augmented DSGE framework that exploits an 88-series euro-area panel while protecting structural inference. Structural parameters are estimated using only core model observables; the broader panel then sharpens inference on latent states and the measurement system conditional on the structural posterior. This separation insulates structural parameters from misspecification in the auxiliary measurement block. In recursive 2011–2019 multivariate point and density forecasts, the augmented Smets-Wouters model outperforms the standard DSGE at every horizon and the jointly estimated DSGE-DFM in five of six comparisons.
title: An augmented DSGE approach to data-rich forecasting

abstract: Green projects often generate environmental benefits that are not fully reflected in private cash flows, creating a wedge between social value and financial viability. This paper develops a two-stage framework that links policy intervention to green bond pricing. In the first stage, we formulate a constrained policy-optimization model that allocates carbon credits and fiscal subsidies to restore project viability under carbon-credit supply constraints, subsidy budget constraints, and institutional limits. The optimization balances discounted policy-preference cost with nominal lifecycle policy resource commitment, thereby embedding a market-first hierarchy in which carbon-credit revenues are prioritized and subsidies are used as a fiscal backstop. In the second stage, we map the optimized policy-adjusted cash flows into an option-pricing model to value the embedded green attribute of green bonds. The framework shows how policy support repairs downside cash-flow shortfalls, shifts green assets from a distressed out-of-the-money state toward an at-the-money state, and allows uncertainty in future environmental value to be capitalized as upside optionality. The empirical results show that carbon credits and subsidies are complementary rather than interchangeable. Carbon credits can restore viability when verified emission reductions are sufficient, whereas subsidies are required when carbon-market revenues are constrained by physical issuance capacity or aggregate credit supply. The analysis further shows that intervention boundaries and carbon price dynamics materially affect policy efficiency, project solvency, and bond valuation. The paper provides a structural explanation of the greenium by linking externality internalization, policy-induced cash-flow repair, and bond-level option value, offering guidance for adaptive green finance policy design.

abstract: In recent years, the environmental impact of medical wastewater has garnered escalating regulatory and scholarly scrutiny. Despite increasingly stringent regulation, hospitals exhibit substantial heterogeneity in discharge behavior. While external regulatory pressure sets the compliance baseline, the extent to which hospitals effectively reduce discharge depends critically on their internal capacity to interpret and respond to regulatory demands. Using a panel dataset of 570 state-owned tertiary hospitals in China (2020–2024), we examine how environmental regulatory pressure directly affects medical wastewater discharge and how management technical proficiency and financial slack moderate this relationship. Results show: (1) Stricter environmental regulation significantly mitigates wastewater discharge from medical institutions, a conclusion that remains robust after addressing endogeneity and exhibits pronounced regional and institutional heterogeneity. (2) Management technical proficiency significantly moderates this relationship; hospitals led by highly technically literate management teams are more likely to proactively adopt advanced green governance strategies, thereby substituting internal initiative for external regulatory dependence. (3) Financial slack similarly exerts a moderating effect; substantial financial buffers empower hospitals to transcend passive compliance and actively pursue operational optimization, whereas financially constrained hospitals rely more heavily on the coercive force of external regulations to improve their environmental performance. This study contributes to the literature by elucidating the behavioral responses of public service organizations to environmental mandates through an integrated External Pressure–Internal Capabilities–Environmental Behavior framework. Furthermore, it offers targeted policy implications to help hospital administrators optimize internal resource allocation for green transitions and assist environmental regulators in formulating differentiated, incentive-based policy interventions for institutions with varying organizational capacities.

abstract: Does investor horizon predict when firms respond to a financing imbalance? We link Chinese firms with domestically listed, renminbi-denominated A-shares to fund-level disclosed positions and classify fund horizons from the preceding four half-years of portfolio turnover. From 2015 to 2023, a one-standard-deviation shift toward long-horizon funds predicts 0.11 percentage points less annual leverage adjustment for a firm ten percentage points from its predicted leverage benchmark. Among funds holding the same overlevered firm, a ten-percentage-point larger gap predicts that long-horizon positions are 1.91 percentage points less likely than short-horizon positions to disappear in the first six months, but 1.62 points more likely in the next six. The combined-year difference is small and imprecise. Nonrandom matching between funds and firms prevents a causal interpretation. Together, the two patterns point to a timing trade-off. Stable ownership predicts less hurried financing, but patience without a credible point of review may leave balance-sheet imbalances unresolved.

abstract: Recent debate over the US $100,000 H-1B visa fee has focused on measuring the wage gap between H-1B workers and comparable native-born workers. We argue that this gap, whatever its size, cannot by itself tell us what the fee would do or whether it is good policy. To answer the first question, we start from economic theory rather than measurement issues in the data. Using a search-and-bargaining model in which H-1B workers cannot change employers, we show that the gap mixes markdowns with the sorting of H-1B workers into less productive firms. We also show that the fee acts as a tax on the output of H-1B matches, and that the workers themselves bear part of it. Whether the fee raises or lowers welfare depends on the elasticity of labour demand, how much bargaining power H-1B workers have, and how congested the labour market is. To answer the second question, we need to be explicit about the policy goal. Because the H-1B system is already a second-best setting, efficiency cannot be separated from justice. Any policy in this setting creates winners and losers, so choosing one means taking a position on justice, even when the case for it is made on efficiency grounds alone. Neutral policy advice should therefore also measure outcomes that matter under non-welfarist conceptions of justice, such as how firms treat visa holders and how the immigration process shapes newcomers’ views of the society they join.

abstract: Cross-cultural research on tax compliance provides two competing explanations for differences in taxpayers’ behavior. The institutional explanation focuses on differences in formal institutions (e.g., fines, frequency of audits), while the cultural explanation emphasizes differences in culture. We provide evidence from a unique setting where two linguistic—and cultural—groups, German and Italian, co-exist within an administrative region under one institutional environment. In our online lab-in-the-field approach (N=190), we conduct a quasi-experimental income reporting game and a within-subject vignette experiment to elicit beliefs. While the overall level of evasion is similar between groups, there is a difference in tax compliance when differentiating between the intensive and extensive margin: Italian speakers evade larger amounts whereas German speakers tend to evade more often. Perceived compliance is lower than actual compliance with German speaking taxpayers being perceived to be more compliant than Italian speaking taxpayers. We further explore the impact of randomized language priming and find mixed results.

abstract: Many observers have asserted that there is a correlation between traders’ emotional states and asset market behaviour, with Joviality associated with high prices and Fear with low prices. In this paper, we conduct a laboratory experiment to examine the direction of causality in this relationship. The results show that moods, induced by videos, shown in virtual reality, do not influence market prices. However, there is a strong relationship between market activity and subsequent emotional states, suggesting that the correlation between emotional state and market activity is driven by the influence of market activity on emotional state, not the other way around.
title: Emotional State and Market Activity: Cause or Consequence?
title_zh: 情绪状态与市场活动：原因还是结果？

abstract: Partial energy taxation, such as fuel or electricity taxes, is gaining momentum in recent years, but such taxes may result in additional demand for non-taxed, substitute energy goods. In this research, we analyze the effect of the Japanese renewable levy, a prime example of incomplete carbon pricing, introduced in 2012. Using data on Japanese plants between April 2004 to March 2020, we utilize the existence of a partial exemption scheme from the tax, and instruments for identification. Our results show that the levy had undesirable consequences, as it is associated with a rebound in emissions for certain sectors where electricity and fuels are substitute (iron & steel, pulp & paper). This rebound is explained by a greater share of electricity generated onsite, powered by fossil fuel. We show that the levy provided an incentive for plants to switch from clean (gas) to dirty (coal, oil) fuels. While the tax is generally correlated with gains in electricity and energy efficiency, these efforts are not enough to offset the rebound in emissions. Our results shed light on the effect of partial energy taxation on the manufacturing industry, and suggest the need for complete forms of carbon pricing.
abstract_zh: 近年来，部分能源税（如燃料税或电力税）日益受到重视，但此类税收可能导致对未征税替代能源商品的额外需求。本研究分析了日本可再生能源税的影响，该税于2012年引入，是不完全碳定价的典型例子。我们使用2004年4月至2020年3月期间日本工厂的数据，利用该税的部分豁免机制及识别工具进行分析。结果表明，该税产生了不良后果，因其与电力与燃料互为替代的某些行业（钢铁、纸浆与造纸）的排放反弹相关。这种反弹可由现场发电（以化石燃料为动力）份额增加来解释。我们表明，该税激励工厂从清洁燃料（天然气）转向肮脏燃料（煤炭、石油）。尽管该税通常与电力和能源效率的提升相关，但这些努力不足以抵消排放反弹。我们的结果揭示了部分能源税对制造业的影响，并表明需要完整的碳定价形式。
title: Feed-in-Tariff with unexpected emission rebound? Incomplete carbon pricing and inter-fuel substitution in manufacturing
title_zh: 上网电价补贴会带来意外的排放反弹吗？制造业中不完整的碳定价与燃料间替代

abstract: In this paper, we describe how the pandemic affected undergraduate enrollment in colleges and universities, with a focus on how these effects vary across programs in different fields of study. We use newly developed administrative data on program enrollment reported by institutions to the National Student Loan Data System (NSLDS) for all students who receive federal support, either grants or loans, to attend college over the past decade. We build upon prior work to examine enrollment (vs. degrees granted) for a national census of aided students and extend analyses into the post-pandemic period. We find that in 2021, when most programs were still being offered remotely, the typical undergraduate program had 8–10% lower enrollment of federal aid recipients than its pre-pandemic trend would have suggested. This aggregate pattern, however, masks considerable variability across sectors and fields. Community college enrollment was hit particularly hard, with the pandemic accelerating existing patterns of enrollment loss in several large fields (Liberal Arts, Security and Protective Services). Large declines in industrial trades ended up being transitory, as short-run supply constraints were removed and enrollment recovered. Both supply- and demand-factors are important to understanding these patterns.
abstract_zh: 本文描述了疫情如何影响高校本科招生，重点关注这些影响在不同学科领域的项目之间如何变化。我们使用新开发的行政数据，这些数据由各院校向国家学生贷款数据系统（NSLDS）报告，涵盖过去十年中所有获得联邦资助（助学金或贷款）上大学的学生。我们在已有研究的基础上，考察获得资助学生的全国普查中的入学情况（而非学位授予情况），并将分析扩展到疫情后时期。我们发现，在2021年，当大多数项目仍以远程方式提供时，典型本科项目的联邦资助受助者入学人数比其疫情前趋势所预示的水平低8%至10%。然而，这一总体模式掩盖了不同部门和领域之间的相当大的差异。社区大学入学受到尤其严重的打击，疫情加速了若干大型领域（人文、安全与保护服务）已有的入学流失模式。工业行业的入学大幅下降最终是暂时性的，因为短期供给约束被消除，入学人数得以恢复。供给因素和需求因素对于理解这些模式都很重要。
title: Pandemic-era shifts in postsecondary enrollment
title_zh: 疫情时期高等教育入学变化

abstract: This paper investigates whether regional industrial capabilities are associated with technological competitiveness in Brazil and how this relationship varies with regional income and applicant type. Industrial and technological relatedness densities (RD) were constructed in a common IPC classification using the Algorithmic Links with Probabilities (ALP) method developed by Lybbert and Zolas (2014) to build a database with employment and patent data for 133 intermediate regions and 121 technology classes over 2006–2021. Results show that both densities are positively associated with technological competitiveness, although neither is statistically significant in low-income regions. Industrial RD is more strongly associated with technological competitiveness of firms than of research institutions. Moreover, Industrial RD is significant for firms even in low-income regions. These findings show that the relationship between regional capabilities and technological competitiveness depends on both regional development and type of patent applicant.
abstract_zh: 本文考察巴西区域工业能力是否与技术竞争力相关，以及这种关系如何随区域收入和申请人类型而变化。研究采用Lybbert和Zolas（2014）开发的概率算法链接（ALP）方法，在共同的IPC分类下构建工业相关密度与技术相关密度（RD），并据此建立涵盖2006—2021年133个中间区域和121个技术类别的就业与专利数据数据库。结果表明，两类密度均与技术竞争力正相关，但在低收入区域二者均不具有统计显著性。工业RD与企业技术竞争力的关联强于其与研究机构技术竞争力的关联。此外，即使在低收入区域，工业RD对企业仍具有显著性。这些发现表明，区域能力与技术竞争力之间的关系同时取决于区域发展水平和专利申请人类型。
title: Industry relatedness and technological diversification across patent applicants: evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 产业关联性与专利申请人技术多元化：来自巴西的证据

abstract: This paper examines how citizens’ direct participation in democratic processes boosts attitudes toward democratic practices. Focusing on compulsory poll working, we argue that citizens selected to work at polling stations on Election Day gain additional information about democratic procedures, and that this shapes their attitudes toward electoral integrity and democracy. We test our claims by leveraging a pre-registered large-scale experiment from the 2023 Colombian regional elections. Based on a unique survey dataset of over 25,000 poll workers matched with a sample of ordinary citizens, we identify a positive and robust causal effect of electoral task management on attitudes toward electoral integrity and democracy that operates mainly via a theory-based mechanism, but also via a practice-based mechanism. Moreover, we discover that this treatment effect is smaller in municipalities heavily affected by political violence during previous civil conflict.
abstract_zh: 本文考察公民直接参与民主过程如何提升其对民主实践的态度。聚焦于强制性投票站工作，我们认为，被选中在选举日于投票站工作的公民会获得关于民主程序的额外信息，而这会塑造其对选举公正性和民主的态度。我们利用2023年哥伦比亚地区选举中一项预先注册的大规模实验来检验我们的主张。基于一个独特的调查数据集——该数据集包含超过25，000名投票站工作人员，并与普通公民样本相匹配——我们识别出选举任务管理对选举公正性和民主态度具有正向且稳健的因果效应，该效应主要通过一种基于理论的机制发挥作用，但也通过一种基于实践的机制发挥作用。此外，我们发现，在先前内战中受政治暴力严重影响的城市，这一处理效应较小。
title: The effect of being a poll worker on democratic attitudes in a post-conflict society: evidence from an experiment in Colombia
title_zh: 担任投票站工作人员对冲突后社会民主态度的影响：来自哥伦比亚一项实验的证据
