title: Comment on “Slackness, Openness, and the Anatomy of Cash Transfer Multipliers” by Minki Kim and Mitchell VanVuren
title_zh: 评Minki Kim与Mitchell VanVuren《松弛、开放与现金转移乘数的解剖》

abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line.
abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲的生育率下降。本文提出一种基于一种普遍但研究不足的信仰体系的补充性解释：祖先影响生者并寻求其血脉的延续。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为一种道德和集体义务，根植于确保血脉存续的精神责任。基于第一手数据、新的民族志信息以及历史和当代调查，我记录了祖先信仰与生育率之间在不同背景和时间段上强烈且数量上显著的正相关关系。一个将子女视为血脉公共品的简单模型可以合理解释数据中观察到的模式：祖先信仰的生育效应集中在父系社会中，并且在子女延续同一家族血脉的兄弟姐妹之间出现了一种特定形式的搭便车行为。
title: Living for the lineage: Ancestral beliefs and the spiritual foundations of fertility in Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 为家族而活：撒哈拉以南非洲的祖先信仰与生育的精神基础

abstract: This paper develops an open economy model with asymmetric information to explain cross-country heterogeneity in the transmission of government spending shocks. Using panel data for 41 countries, we find that a positive government spending shock strongly stimulates consumption and depreciates the real exchange rate in countries with countercyclical fiscal policy, whereas in countries with procyclical fiscal policy, the crowding-in effect on consumption is weaker and the real exchange rate appreciates. To account for these patterns, we build an open economy New Keynesian model in which fiscal policy conveys information about economic conditions. A change in government purchases reveals the government’s assessment of the state of the economy, leading private agents to form misaligned beliefs about economic fluctuations. Crucially, this signaling effect depends on a country’s fiscal cyclicality. Evidence from professional forecasts supports this information channel.
abstract_zh: 本文构建一个包含信息不对称的开放经济模型，以解释政府支出冲击传导的跨国异质性。基于41个国家的面板数据，我们发现正向政府支出冲击在实施逆周期财政政策的国家会强烈刺激消费并使实际汇率贬值，而在实施顺周期财政政策的国家，对消费的挤入效应较弱且实际汇率升值。为解释这些模式，我们构建一个开放经济新凯恩斯模型，其中财政政策传递关于经济状况的信息。政府购买的变化揭示政府对经济状态的评估，导致私人主体对经济波动形成错位信念。关键在于，这一信号效应取决于一国的财政周期性。来自专业预测的证据支持这一信息渠道。
title: Fiscal cyclicality and the information channel of government spending shocks
title_zh: 财政周期性与政府支出冲击的信息渠道

abstract: Do elites ever exchange sovereignty and power for wealth? In 1707, Scottish parliamentarians sacrificed their political power by voting to unite with England to form a new nation. Despite this moment’s significance, the factors driving the voting decisions of individual MPs remain in dispute. I collect financial data from archival documents dating from 1695 to 1709. After combining this data with historical biographies, I construct a novel MP-level dataset for the last Scottish parliament. I reveal the impact of England’s promised £398,085 financial package (roughly US$1.6 billion today) 1 1 See Officer and Williamson (2026). , known as the Equivalent, on the willingness of MPs to vote in favor of union. To identify the Equivalent’s causal effect, I leverage plausibly random variation in parliamentary attendance. I then exploit the double coincidence of attending parliament in 1695 and eligibility for compensation. I find that eligibility for compensation increased the probability of voting for union by over 30%. I present evidence that the Act of Union would not have passed without the Equivalent.
abstract_zh: 精英是否会以主权和权力换取财富？1707年，苏格兰议员通过投票与英格兰联合组成一个新国家，从而牺牲了自己的政治权力。尽管这一时刻意义重大，但驱动个别议员投票决策的因素仍存在争议。我收集了1695年至1709年间档案文件中的财务数据。在将这些数据与历史传记相结合后，我为最后一届苏格兰议会构建了一个新颖的议员层面数据集。我揭示了英格兰承诺的398,085英镑财政方案（按今日价值约16亿美元）1 1 见Officer and Williamson（2026）。——被称为“等价物”——对议员投票支持联合意愿的影响。为了识别“等价物”的因果效应，我利用了议会出席情况中看似随机的变异。随后，我利用了1695年出席议会与获得补偿资格这一双重巧合。我发现，获得补偿资格使投票支持联合的概率提高了30%以上。我提供的证据表明，如果没有“等价物”，《联合法案》就不会通过。
title: The price of a nation: The effects of financial incentives on support for union in Scotland
title_zh: 一个国家的代价：财政激励对苏格兰联盟支持的影响

abstract: Why does so little private capital flow to poor countries? We study how venture capital and private equity investors evaluate firms across countries, using an experimental survey of 1,485 investors in 108 countries who are incentivized to evaluate hypothetical investment opportunities with randomized firm characteristics, locations, and investment terms. Investors respond similarly to firm fundamentals, but otherwise comparable firms attract substantially less interest in poorer countries. This poor-country penalty is much smaller among investors specialized in emerging markets. Detailed survey data show that emerging market and developed market investors have largely similar investment practices, but differ in how they obtain country information, assess and manage country risks, and exit investments. Investors reporting active country-risk management apply smaller country penalties, even after accounting for market focus. Our findings suggest that investors' specialization and investment practices shape how country risk affects investment: the same firm can face drastically different financing prospects depending on where it is located and which investors evaluate it.
abstract_zh: 为什么流向贫穷国家的私人资本如此之少？我们通过一项实验性调查，研究了风险投资和私募股权投资者如何评估不同国家的企业。该调查覆盖108个国家的1,485名投资者，并通过激励措施促使他们评估具有随机化企业特征、地点和投资条款的假设性投资机会。投资者对企业基本面的反应相似，但除此之外条件可比的企业在较贫穷国家获得的兴趣要低得多。这种贫穷国家惩罚在专注于新兴市场的投资者中要小得多。详细的调查数据显示，新兴市场和发达市场投资者的投资实践大体相似，但在获取国家信息、评估和管理国家风险以及退出投资的方式上存在差异。报告积极进行国家风险管理的投资者施加的国家惩罚较小，即使在考虑了市场专注度之后也是如此。我们的发现表明，投资者的专业化和投资实践塑造了国家风险如何影响投资：同一家企业可能因所在地不同以及由哪些投资者评估而面临截然不同的融资前景。
title: How Does Capital Flow To Poor Countries? Evidence from Venture Capital and Private Equity
title_zh: 资本如何流向贫穷国家？来自风险投资和私募股权的证据

abstract: This paper explores how economic growth driven by AI will impact the developing world. Our analysis is based on a growth model of a developed and developing economy where AI services are traded on the world market, and may substitute for or complement different labor inputs in production. Preferences allow for the possibility that demand for services provided by AI has an upper bound. The model predicts that developing countries may not benefit as much from AI-driven growth. First, they may lack complementary skills needed to fully utilize AI domestically. Second, they may be priced out of world markets due to their relatively lower productivity. We use our model to simulate how growth and welfare are affected by making workers more complementary to AI, subsidizing compute, speeding technology diffusion, and providing cash transfers. Numerical simulations of the model suggest that the potential for developing countries to be left behind – or having some workers lose in absolute terms – is substantial enough that researchers should study the impacts of AI on developing countries in real time.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨AI驱动的经济增长将如何影响发展中国家。我们的分析基于一个发达经济体和发展中经济体的增长模型，其中AI服务在世界市场上交易，并可能替代或互补生产中的不同劳动投入。偏好设定允许对AI所提供服务的需求存在上限的可能性。模型预测，发展中国家可能无法从AI驱动的增长中获益那么多。首先，它们可能缺乏在国内充分利用AI所需的互补技能。其次，由于相对较低的生产率，它们可能在世界市场中被价格挤出。我们使用模型模拟了使劳动者与AI更具互补性、补贴算力、加快技术扩散以及提供现金转移支付如何影响增长和福利。模型的数值模拟表明，发展中国家被甩在后面的可能性——或部分劳动者出现绝对损失的可能性——足够大，研究人员应当实时研究AI对发展中国家的影响。
title: Will AI Growth Reach the Developing World?
title_zh: AI增长会惠及发展中国家吗？

abstract: In the US federal system, the federal government provides substantial fiscal support to state and local governments. In this paper, we describe how the landscape of intergovernmental grants, which exceeded $1.2 trillion in 2025, evolved during and in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic. We provide short-run evidence on how state and local government budgets have adapted as pandemic-era fiscal supports wound down. We further emphasize the pressures state and local budgets will face as several provisions of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), which are intended to restrain intergovernmental grants, go into effect over the coming years.
abstract_zh: 在美国联邦体制中，联邦政府向州和地方政府提供大量财政支持。在本文中，我们描述了2025年超过1.2万亿美元的政府间拨款格局在COVID-19大流行期间及之后如何演变。我们提供了关于州和地方政府预算在大流行时期财政支持逐步退出时如何调整的短期证据。我们进一步强调，随着《One Big Beautiful Bill Act》（OBBBA）中旨在限制政府间拨款的若干条款在未来几年生效，州和地方预算将面临的压力。
title: The Recent and Impending Evolution of US Federal Support for State and Local Governments
title_zh: 美国联邦对州和地方政府支持的近期与即将到来的演变

abstract: Despite pregnancy-focused public insurance coverage in the U.S., low-income mothers and infants face persistent health disadvantages. Using linked birth, tax, and enrollment data, we examine the effects of preconception coverage from California's 2014 Medicaid expansion, comparing changes in outcomes for first-time mothers just below and above the income eligibility threshold. Expansion increased preconception Medicaid enrollment by 3.4 months (+23 percentage points in 12-month continuous coverage), first-month pregnancy enrollment by 24 percentage points, and adequate prenatal care and STI screening. Yet we find no improvements in maternal or infant health, suggesting preconception coverage alone cannot close health disparities.
abstract_zh: 尽管美国有针对怀孕的公共保险覆盖，低收入母亲和婴儿仍面临持续的健康劣势。利用关联的出生、税务和参保数据，我们考察了加州2014年Medicaid扩展带来的孕前覆盖的影响，比较了收入资格阈值两侧首次生育母亲的结果变化。扩展使孕前Medicaid参保增加了3.4个月（12个月连续覆盖增加23个百分点），妊娠第一个月参保增加24个百分点，并提高了充分产前护理和性传播感染筛查。然而，我们未发现母婴健康有所改善，这表明仅靠孕前覆盖无法弥合健康差距。
title: Preconception Medicaid and Maternal and Infant Health: Evidence from Linked Administrative Data
title_zh: 孕前Medicaid与母婴健康：来自关联行政数据的证据

abstract: We map the financial network supporting the AI buildout. Substantial equity cushions protect creditors against large obligations outstanding in mid-2026, but concentrated exposures and interconnected claims create weak links. Our calibrated model supports a large compute expansion in the coming years. The equilibrium investment exceeds the social optimum because firms do not internalize their effects on competitors' revenues. Debt finances nearly 60% of the expansion, increasing leverage, while non-recourse borrowing leaves project lenders exposed despite equity buffers. In the low-productivity state, losses reach $16.8 trillion across shareholders and creditors, with 40% loss-given-default on debt. Suppressing contractual payment spillovers among the key firms reduces private losses by approximately 30%, revealing substantial network propagation.
abstract_zh: 我们绘制了支撑AI建设的金融网络。大量股权缓冲保护债权人免受2026年中期巨额未偿债务的影响，但集中敞口和相互关联的债权形成了薄弱环节。我们校准的模型支持未来几年大规模的算力扩张。均衡投资超过社会最优，因为企业未将其对竞争对手收入的影响内部化。债务为扩张融资近60%，提高了杠杆率，而无追索权借款使项目贷款人尽管有股权缓冲仍面临敞口。在低生产率状态下，股东和债权人的损失达到16.8万亿美元，债务的违约损失率为40%。抑制关键企业之间的合同支付溢出可将私人损失减少约30%，揭示了显著的网络传播。
title: Clouds of Credit: Mapping the Financial Web Behind AI Compute
title_zh: 信贷之云：绘制AI算力背后的金融网络

abstract: The infamous agricultural pest, the boll weevil, spread across southern US counties between 1892 and 1920. It had devastating impacts on cotton production, a highly child-labor-intensive crop. This study examines how the arrival of the boll weevil and the subsequent reductions in child labor affect later-life mortality outcomes. Using Social Security Administration death records linked with the 1940 census, we document that the staggered spread of the boll weevil improved the longevity of exposed male children. Full exposure to the boll weevil is associated with an intent-to-treat effect of 1-3 months of higher longevity. We show that the estimated effects are robust across a wide array of specifications, are not driven by sociodemographic and socioeconomic compositional change in the final sample, and are not associated with pre-existing trends in the outcome. Further, we find larger impacts among Blacks, children of lower educated mothers, whose fathers work in the farming industry, and those born in high cotton intensity counties. Moreover, the effects appear to be substantially larger among children in states with less restrictive child labor policies, implying the role of these policies in reducing the adverse effects of child labor in the absence of the boll weevil in cotton production counties. Affected children are more likely to migrate, and their destination counties are more likely to be urban and have higher socioeconomic scores. The 1940 census suggests that the exposed children attain higher levels of education and have higher socioeconomic scores. We discuss the policy implications of these results in relation to child labor and school attendance policies in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 臭名昭著的农业害虫棉铃象鼻虫在1892年至1920年间蔓延至美国南部各县。它对棉花生产造成了毁灭性影响，而棉花是一种高度依赖童工的作物。本研究考察棉铃象鼻虫的到来及随后童工减少如何影响晚年死亡率结果。利用与社会保障局死亡记录相关联的1940年人口普查数据，我们记录了棉铃象鼻虫的交错蔓延改善了暴露男性儿童的寿命。完全暴露于棉铃象鼻虫与意向性治疗效应相关，即寿命延长1-3个月。我们表明，估计效应在广泛的一系列设定中稳健，并非由最终样本的社会人口和社会经济构成变化所驱动，也与结果的既有趋势无关。此外，我们发现黑人、母亲受教育程度较低者、父亲从事农业者以及出生在棉花密集度高县的儿童中影响更大。而且，在童工政策限制较少的州，儿童中的效应似乎大得多，这意味着在棉花生产县没有棉铃象鼻虫的情况下，这些政策在减少童工不利影响方面的作用。受影响的儿童更可能迁移，其目的地县更可能为城市且社会经济得分更高。1940年人口普查表明，暴露儿童获得了更高的教育水平并具有更高的社会经济得分。我们讨论了这些结果与发展中国家童工和入学政策相关的政策含义。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为美国南部棉铃象鼻虫与童工，数据为美国社保与1940年人口普查，与中国无关。
title: A Blessing in Disguise: The Long-Term Effects of Childhood Exposure to the Boll Weevil on Old-Age Male Longevity
title_zh: 因祸得福：童年接触棉铃象鼻虫对老年男性寿命的长期影响

abstract: Tracking Pakistani students over 15 years, we use two identification strategies to provide the first causal evidence linking learning in primary school to adult outcomes in a low-income country. Exposure to a school with higher test score value-added increases educational attainment and earnings 15 years later. A randomized information intervention that led to learning gains at the village level generated similar effects. Lifetime earnings gains across all students attending a 1sd better school total US$175,000, and for the information intervention, the marginal value of public funds is infinity for men. There is a strong economic case for investing in learning.
abstract_zh: 我们追踪巴基斯坦学生超过15年，采用两种识别策略，首次提供了将小学阶段学习与低收入国家成年后结果联系起来的因果证据。就读于考试成绩增值更高的学校，会提高15年后的教育程度和收入。一项随机信息干预在村庄层面带来了学习收益，也产生了类似效果。所有就读于高出1个标准差学校的学生，其终生收入增益合计为175,000美元；对于信息干预，男性的公共资金边际价值为无穷大。投资于学习具有强有力的经济理由。
title: Learn to Earn: The Long-Term Effects of Foundational Learning
title_zh: 学会赚钱：基础学习的长期影响

abstract: Researchers and policymakers in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) have customarily relied on indirect evidence to justify investments in learning, either by linking test scores to economic growth or by connecting adult cognitive assessments to earnings. This reliance on indirect evidence largely stems from the scarcity of longitudinal data linking school-age learning to adult earnings. We address this gap by using data from Ethiopia, India, Pakistan, and Peru to estimate associations between foundational learning (FL), measured by test scores around age 12, and human capital and earnings in young adulthood. In Peru, India, and Pakistan, a one-standard-deviation increase in FL is associated with an 8-13 log point increase in adult earnings. Childhood scores also predict 1.1-1.5 additional years of schooling and 9.3-13.5 percentage points higher college or vocational attendance, as well as higher skills in adulthood. Interestingly, a linear-projection decomposition indicates that measured schooling and adult test scores explain between 18% (Peru) to 50-56% (India and Pakistan) of the FL-earnings gradient, suggesting that FL may raise earnings over and above the association with schooling and adult scores. Finally, FL can account for about 5-12 percent of the earnings gap between young Ethiopians and Indians in our sample, a number that could rise to 33 percent as returns to learning grow over the life cycle. We interpret these descriptive findings in light of recent causal evidence on the learning-to-earnings pipeline and discuss the implications for policy investments in FL.
abstract_zh: 低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的研究者和政策制定者通常依赖间接证据来证明投资于学习的合理性，方法是将考试成绩与经济增长联系起来，或将成人认知评估与收入联系起来。这种对间接证据的依赖在很大程度上源于将学龄期学习与成年收入联系起来的纵向数据稀缺。我们利用埃塞俄比亚、印度、巴基斯坦和秘鲁的数据来填补这一空白，估计以12岁左右的考试成绩衡量的基础学习（FL）与成年早期人力资本和收入之间的关联。在秘鲁、印度和巴基斯坦，FL每提高1个标准差，与成年收入增加8-13个对数点相关。儿童期成绩还预测受教育年限增加1.1-1.5年，大学或职业教育的就读率提高9.3-13.5个百分点，以及成年后技能更高。有趣的是，线性投影分解表明，测得的学校教育和成人考试成绩解释了FL-收入梯度的18%（秘鲁）至50-56%（印度和巴基斯坦），这表明FL可能在 schooling 和成人成绩关联之外提高收入。最后，FL可以解释我们样本中埃塞俄比亚青年和印度青年之间收入差距的约5-12%，随着学习回报在整个生命周期中增长，这一数字可能升至33%。我们结合近期关于学习到收入管道的因果证据来解读这些描述性发现，并讨论对FL政策投资的启示。
title: Childhood Learning and Adult Earnings in Four LMIC Cohorts
title_zh: 四个中低收入国家队列中的儿童期学习与成年收入

abstract: Whether vehicle safety technologies reduce crash injuries and fatalities is relevant to consumers and regulators, but rigorous real world evidence is limited because drivers who choose optional features differ from those who do not. As a natural experiment, we leveraged the staggered implementation of automatic emergency braking as standard rather than optional equipment on 39 vehicle models between 2017 and 2022. Across the United States, the percentage of crash injuries from rear-end collisions caused by the vehicle fell from 13.9% to 8.0% at the first standard model year, and the percentage of crash fatalities fell from 6.0% to 4.7%. Neither fell in models that never standardized the technology, and crash types it was not designed to prevent were unaffected. Automatic emergency braking reduces crash injuries and fatalities.
abstract_zh: 车辆安全技术是否减少碰撞伤害和死亡对消费者和监管者具有相关性，但严格的现实世界证据有限，因为选择可选功能的驾驶员与不选择者不同。作为自然实验，我们利用2017年至2022年间39款车型将自动紧急制动作为标准而非可选设备的分阶段实施。在全美国范围内，由该车辆造成的追尾碰撞伤害百分比在第一个标准车型年从13.9%降至8.0%，碰撞死亡百分比从6.0%降至4.7%。在从未标准化该技术的车型中，两者均未下降，且该技术并非设计用于预防的碰撞类型未受影响。自动紧急制动减少了碰撞伤害和死亡。
title: Crash Injuries and Fatalities in the United States Following Standardization of Automatic Emergency Braking
title_zh: 美国自动紧急制动标准化后的碰撞伤害和死亡

abstract: We analyze a historical episode to generate evidence on how federal eminent domain authority affected construction of energy transportation infrastructure. The 1947 amendment to the Natural Gas Act gave federally approved interstate natural gas pipelines the power to acquire rights of way by eminent domain when negotiations with landowners failed. We compare construction of interstate gas pipelines with construction of oil pipelines and of within-state gas pipelines, neither of which was directly affected by the reform, using newly digitized historical government records and trade press listings. After 1947, annual additions to interstate gas pipeline mileage rose nearly sixfold while oil pipeline growth held steady, and the gain in interstate mileage was nearly five times the gain for within-state pipelines. Both comparisons suggest that the amendment substantially increased interstate gas pipeline construction. We discuss what this historical evidence implies for current congressional proposals to provide federal eminent domain authority for interstate electricity transmission.
abstract_zh: 我们分析一个历史事件，以生成关于联邦征用权如何影响能源运输基础设施建设证据。1947年《天然气法》修正案赋予联邦批准的州际天然气管道在与土地所有者谈判失败时通过征用权获得通行权的权力。我们使用新数字化的历史政府记录和行业媒体列表，比较州际天然气管道建设与石油管道和州内天然气管道建设，后两者均未直接受改革影响。1947年后，州际天然气管道里程的年增量增长了近六倍，而石油管道增长保持稳定，州际里程的增益几乎是州内管道增益的五倍。两项比较均表明，该修正案大幅增加了州际天然气管道建设。我们讨论这一历史证据对当前国会提案为州际电力传输提供联邦征用权的启示。
title: Federal Eminent Domain and Interstate Energy Infrastructure: Evidence from History
title_zh: 联邦征用权与州际能源基础设施：来自历史的证据

abstract: A growing number of local police departments now hold authority to enforce federal immigration law, a role traditionally reserved for federal officers. Despite claims that this authority enhances public safety, empirical evidence remains limited. Using FBI Uniform Crime Report data from 2000–2024, we exploit staggered adoption across U.S. jurisdictions to estimate causal effects on policing. We find that this enforcement authority increases arrests for low-level, discretionary offenses by approximately 7%, with no corresponding decreases in offense rates or serious crime. These results suggest that such agreements realign police priorities toward discretionary enforcement without measurable public safety benefits.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的地方警察部门现在拥有执行联邦移民法的权力，这一角色传统上保留给联邦官员。尽管声称这一权力增强了公共安全，但经验证据仍然有限。我们使用2000-2024年FBI统一犯罪报告数据，利用美国司法管辖区的分阶段采用来估计对警务的因果影响。我们发现，这一执法权力使低级别、自由裁量犯罪的逮捕增加了约7%，而犯罪率或严重犯罪没有相应下降。这些结果表明，此类协议将警察优先事项重新调整为自由裁量执法，而没有可衡量的公共安全益处。
title: Crime on ICE: Local Police Behavior and Immigration Enforcement in the United States
title_zh: ICE上的犯罪：美国地方警察行为与移民执法

abstract: Observational associations between red meat consumption and cardiometabolic disease are confounded by diet and other health behaviors. Alpha-gal syndrome, a tick-borne allergy to mammalian meat, leads to an abrupt and involuntary cessation of red meat consumption. Using national electronic health records, we compared changes in weight and cardiometabolic health over two years before and after newly detected alpha-gal syndrome with those in patients with other tick-borne diseases, who were also bitten and sought care but whose diagnoses carry no dietary restriction. Relative to this comparison group, diagnosis of alpha-gal syndrome led to a sustained 0.8 kg (95% CI, 0.6 to 1.0) reduction in body weight that increased with the degree of sensitization, as well as small reductions in triglycerides, glycated hemoglobin, glucose, and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol. Not eating red meat appears to yield modest but measurable cardiometabolic benefits.
abstract_zh: 红肉消费与心脏代谢疾病之间的观察性关联受到饮食和其他健康行为的混杂。α-半乳糖综合征是一种由蜱传播的哺乳动物肉过敏，导致突然和非自愿地停止红肉消费。我们使用国家电子健康记录，比较了新检测出α-半乳糖综合征的患者在诊断前后两年内体重和心脏代谢健康的变化，与患有其他蜱传播疾病的患者进行比较，后者也被叮咬并寻求护理，但其诊断不带有饮食限制。相对于这一比较组，α-半乳糖综合征的诊断导致体重持续减少0.8 kg（95% CI，0.6至1.0），且随致敏程度增加而增加，同时甘油三酯、糖化血红蛋白、葡萄糖和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇略有降低。不吃红肉似乎产生适度但可测量的心脏代谢益处。
title: The Health Effects of Eating Red Meat: A Natural Experiment in Alpha-Gal Syndrome
title_zh: 吃红肉的健康影响：α-半乳糖综合征中的自然实验

abstract: Parents who want to financially support their child’s pursuit of higher education must save against assumptions about what college will cost and how it will be funded. This study examines how parental beliefs and future borrowing costs shape college saving decisions. Through a survey experiment with an embedded financial planning tool, we elicit parental beliefs about the future costs of college and their expectations of different funding sources, including financial aid and student loans. We find that nearly all parents want to cover some of the future costs of college, but many may fall short in their savings due to underestimating future expenses and overestimating available financial aid. A corrective information intervention encourages most parents to recalibrate their saving target. However, when a substantial gap between expected and actual costs is combined with a salient high repayment burden for their child, we find a discouragement effect that diminishes both their willingness to save and their aspirations for their child’s educational attainment. We calibrate a model of parental saving with learning about college costs, which reproduces both the absence of an average response to borrowing costs and the shift of children away from college attendance, and use it to price the welfare cost of misperception. Parents with higher financial literacy hold better-calibrated beliefs and respond more to correction. We discuss policy implications for outreach activities to support informed financial planning for college education.
abstract_zh: 希望为子女追求高等教育提供经济支持的父母，必须基于对大学费用以及资金来源的假设进行储蓄。本研究考察父母信念和未来借贷成本如何塑造大学储蓄决策。通过一项嵌入财务规划工具的调查实验，我们引出父母对大学未来费用的信念以及他们对不同资金来源（包括经济援助和学生贷款）的预期。我们发现，几乎所有父母都希望覆盖部分未来大学费用，但许多人可能因低估未来支出和高估可用经济援助而在储蓄上不足。一项纠正性信息干预促使大多数父母重新校准其储蓄目标。然而，当预期成本与实际成本之间的巨大差距与子女面临显著的高还款负担相结合时，我们发现一种挫败效应，既削弱了他们的储蓄意愿，也削弱了他们对子女教育成就的期望。我们校准了一个包含大学成本学习的父母储蓄模型，该模型再现了对借贷成本平均反应缺失以及子女远离大学入学的转变，并用其估算误知的福利成本。金融素养较高的父母持有校准更好的信念，并对纠正信息反应更强。我们讨论了支持知情大学教育财务规划的 outreach 活动的政策含义。
title: The Role of Parental Beliefs and Public Policies in Financing Higher Education: An Experimental Study
title_zh: 父母信念与公共政策在高等教育融资中的作用：一项实验研究

abstract: Lucas (1990) asked why capital does not flow from rich to poor countries. When poor countries opened their stock markets to foreign investors in the late 1980s, it did: rich-country capital arbitraged away the excess return on emerging-market equity and created a new asset class. Infrastructure may offer the last such arbitrage. The median social return on paved roads in poor countries was 3.7 times the return on U.S. capital at the time of liberalization, but investors capture only the share of social returns that contracts, user fees, and political risk allow, a constraint we call the private foreign hurdle. Confidential IFC data show that its infrastructure equity portfolio outperformed the S&P 500 by 2 percentage points per year, even though only 41 percent of individual investments in the portfolio did so. This suggests that strong risk-adjusted portfolio returns can mask substantial project-specific uncertainty. Despite high social returns, transportation accounted for just 9 IFC infrastructure project investments versus 157 in power and telecommunications. This raises the question of whether private investors can appropriate enough of the social returns on infrastructure to make these investments. Moreover, investors cannot learn from returns they cannot see. Disclosure of historical equity returns is therefore necessary, but not sufficient, to efficiently mobilize more private capital for infrastructure. Because the benefits of disclosure accrue to the market, not to any one firm, multilateral development banks, working with an independent research partner, are best placed to provide it.
abstract_zh: Lucas（1990）追问为何资本不从富国流向穷国。当穷国在1980年代末向外国投资者开放股票市场时，资本确实流入了：富国资本套利掉了新兴市场股票的超额回报，并创造了一个新的资产类别。基础设施可能提供最后这样的套利机会。在自由化时期，穷国铺装道路的社会回报中位数为美国资本回报的3.7倍，但投资者只能获取合同、使用者收费和政治风险所允许的那部分社会回报，我们将这一约束称为私人外国门槛。国际金融公司（IFC）的机密数据显示，其基础设施股权组合每年跑赢标普500指数2个百分点，尽管该组合中仅有41%的单项投资做到了这一点。这表明强劲的风险调整后组合回报可能掩盖了巨大的项目特定不确定性。尽管社会回报很高，交通仅占IFC基础设施项目投资的9项，而电力和电信为157项。这提出了私人投资者能否占有足够多的基础设施社会回报以使这些投资可行的问题。此外，投资者无法从他们看不见的回报中学习。因此，披露历史股权回报对于有效动员更多私人资本进入基础设施是必要的，但并不充分。由于披露的收益归于市场而非任何单一企业，多边开发银行与独立研究伙伴合作最适合提供这一披露。
title: The Last Arbitrage? Capital Flows, Development, and Infrastructure as an Asset Class
title_zh: 最后的套利？资本流动、发展与作为资产类别的基础设施

abstract: We report findings from the first wave of a survey of undergraduates including separate samples of Dartmouth students, graduating high school seniors, and U.S. college students more broadly. Students report extensive use of AI both for tasks which are likely harmful to learning and tasks which are likely helpful to learning. Students report much higher peer misuse of AI relative to reports of own misuse. Ninety-two percent of students agree or strongly agree that use of AI is harmful to writing. Use of graded out-of-class assignments has become increasingly unfair due to cheating with AI. But students see the value of using AI to answer conceptual questions in real time, create practice quizzes and study guides and to enable meaningful and efficient progress on research projects. Eighty-four percent of Dartmouth respondents report that AI is changing the nature of jobs in their desired (future) field as opposed to eliminating jobs. AI’s perceived value and harms vary widely by academic discipline suggesting that use, rules, and approaches must also vary greatly based on the discipline and context. Students are largely self-taught in AI but have strong demand for incorporating AI effectively in the curriculum.
abstract_zh: 我们报告了一轮本科生调查的发现，样本包括达特茅斯学院学生、即将毕业的高中生以及更广泛的美国大学生等独立样本。学生报告在可能有害于学习的任务和可能有助于学习的任务中都广泛使用AI。学生报告同伴滥用AI的程度远高于自己滥用AI的报告。92%的学生同意或强烈同意使用AI对写作有害。由于利用AI作弊，计分课外作业已变得越来越不公平。但学生看到了使用AI实时回答概念性问题、创建练习测验和学习指南以及使研究项目取得有意义且高效进展的价值。84%的达特茅斯受访者报告，AI正在改变其期望（未来）领域的工作性质，而非消除工作。AI的感知价值和危害因学科而异，差异很大，表明使用、规则和方法也必须因学科和情境而大不相同。学生在AI方面 largely 是自学的，但对将AI有效纳入课程有强烈需求。
title: Impacts of AI in Higher Education: A Panel Survey of Undergraduates
title_zh: 人工智能在高等教育中的影响：本科生面板调查

abstract: This chapter provides an overview of the rapidly evolving economics literature on mental health, focusing on research published since 2015. This literature has grown substantially, reflecting the increased recognition of the prevalence and economic costs of mental illness, declining stigma, and the growing availability of data on mental health. In addition to the economic costs of mental illness, the review focuses on four broad classes of determinants of mental health: endowments, economic resources, education, and trauma. We also examine the determinants and effects of mental health treatment. Finally, we discuss how certain features of mental illness, including its episodic and recurrent nature, pose challenges for the canonical health capital model.
abstract_zh: 本章概述了快速演变的心理健康经济学文献，重点关注2015年以来发表的研究。该文献大幅增长，反映了对精神疾病患病率和经济成本的认识提高、污名化下降以及心理健康数据的日益可得。除精神疾病的经济成本外，本综述聚焦四类广泛的心理健康决定因素：禀赋、经济资源、教育和创伤。我们还考察心理健康治疗的决定因素和效果。最后，我们讨论精神疾病的某些特征（包括其发作性和复发性）如何对经典健康资本模型构成挑战。
title: Economics of Mental Health
title_zh: 心理健康经济学

abstract: Reading is a foundational skill, yet fewer than one in three US fourth graders read at a proficient level. How best to teach reading and improve educational attainment has been an active policy debate for decades. Recently, phonics-based approaches have surged in popularity, even though the largest attempt to put similar methods into classrooms was previously abandoned out of concerns that the program was ineffective. This paper studies Reading First, a nearly $1 billion per year federal program established under No Child Left Behind that promoted phonics-based instruction in K-3 classrooms. Exploiting administrative data from Texas and program eligibility formulas, we estimate effects via difference-in-differences and instrumental variables specifications. We find that eligibility increased third-grade reading test scores by 0.1 standard deviations and that effects persisted through at least the eighth grade. An analysis of digitized exam questions shows that treated students outperformed peers on questions that required basic decoding skills and those with more words, a benefit that also drove improvements in math scores. We follow exposed cohorts into early adulthood, finding that the program increased on-time high school graduation, college enrollment, four-year college completion, and adult earnings at age 25.
abstract_zh: 阅读是一项基础技能，但美国四年级学生中阅读达到熟练水平的不足三分之一。如何最好地教授阅读并提高教育成就，数十年来一直是政策辩论的活跃议题。近年来，基于自然拼读的方法人气激增，尽管此前将类似方法引入课堂的最大规模尝试因担心该项目无效而被放弃。本文研究《阅读优先》（Reading First），这是《不让一个孩子掉队》法案下设立的每年近10亿美元的联邦项目，旨在在K-3课堂推广基于自然拼读的教学。利用德克萨斯州的行政数据和项目资格公式，我们通过双重差分和工具变量设定估计效应。我们发现，资格使三年级阅读测试成绩提高了0.1个标准差，且效应至少持续到八年级。对数字化试题的分析表明，受处理学生在需要基本解码技能的题目以及字数更多的题目上表现优于同伴，这一收益也推动了数学成绩的提升。我们追踪受暴露队列进入成年早期，发现该项目提高了按时高中毕业率、大学入学率、四年制大学毕业率以及25岁时的成年收入。
title: Decoding Success: Phonics-based Instruction and Student Achievement
title_zh: 解码成功：基于自然拼读的教学与学生成绩

abstract: Regressions with many fixed effects are central to applied research, but fitting them to large datasets can be slow. In this article, I present the commands fereg and feppml, which fit linear and Poisson pseudo-maximum-likelihood regressions with high-dimensional fixed effects. Both commands use familiar Stata syntax and pass the computation to a compiled plugin. The plugin chooses among projection, Krylov, and multigrid solvers according to the structure of the fixed effects, checks every result before posting it, and runs on several processor cores. The commands support multiple and interacted fixed effects, group-specific slopes, regression weights, robust and multiway clustered standard errors, saved fixed effects, and prediction. Two simulated examples illustrate their use. In simulated designs with up to ten million observations and default stopping settings, fereg was 6–204 times faster than reghdfe and feppml 11–103 times faster than ppmlhdfe. The commands were also faster than fixest (R) and PyFixest (Python) in all 53 simulated configurations and than the Julia packages FixedEffectModels.jl and GLFixedEffectModels.jl in 52 of 53, with geometric-mean time ratios between 3.0 and 7.7. On administrative data with 1.2 million workers and 117,000 firms, fereg and feppml were at least 3.4 times faster than every other command at every number of cores.
abstract_zh: 包含许多固定效应的回归是应用研究的核心，但在大型数据集上拟合它们可能很慢。本文介绍命令fereg和feppml，它们拟合具有高维固定效应的线性回归和泊松伪最大似然回归。两个命令都使用熟悉的Stata语法，并将计算传递给编译插件。该插件根据固定效应的结构在投影、Krylov和多网格求解器之间选择，在发布每个结果前进行检查，并在多个处理器核心上运行。这些命令支持多重和交互固定效应、组别特定斜率、回归权重、稳健和多向聚类标准误、保存固定效应以及预测。两个模拟示例说明了它们的用法。在最多1000万观测值且使用默认停止设置的模拟设计中，fereg比reghdfe快6–204倍，feppml比ppmlhdfe快11–103倍。这些命令在所有53个模拟配置中也快于fixest（R）和PyFixest（Python），并在53个配置中的52个快于Julia包FixedEffectModels.jl和GLFixedEffectModels.jl，几何平均时间比在3.0到7.7之间。在包含120万工人和117,000家企业的行政数据上，fereg和feppml在每个核心数下都至少比其他所有命令快3.4倍。
title: fereg: Fast High-Dimensional Fixed-Effects Regressions in Stata
title_zh: fereg：Stata中的快速高维固定效应回归

abstract: The Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) plans to implement a pilot switching 340B from an upfront discount model to a rebate model for drugs in the Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program (MDPNP). This study uses calibration methods to predict the impact of the rebate model pilot (RMP) on covered entities’ net revenues from the 340B program. I examine possible losses from averted duplicate discounts; denial of valid claims; manufacturers using data to exert influence; liquidity-related expenses; and administrative and staffing costs. I also project the effects of switching the entire 340B program to a rebate model. I project net revenue losses from the RMP of $1.5 billion. Expansion to all of 340B would increase the predicted losses to $22.8 billion, cutting net revenues from the program by 32%. The majority of losses will come from administrative and staffing costs, which do not benefit manufacturers, implying a net negative effect of switching to a rebate model. Covered entity losses from the RMP will be limited by the pilot only applying to a small percentage of 340B sales as well as restrictions HRSA’s guidance places on manufacturers. If the rebate model expands to all of 340B or if the restrictions are inadequately enforced, the losses will grow substantially.
abstract_zh: 美国卫生资源与服务管理局（HRSA）计划实施一项试点，将针对《医疗保险药品价格谈判计划》（MDPNP）内药品的340B从预先折扣模式转为返利模式。本研究采用校准方法预测返利模式试点（RMP）对覆盖实体从340B计划获得的净收入的影响。我考察了以下方面可能造成的损失：被避免的重复折扣；有效索赔被拒；制造商利用数据施加影响；与流动性相关的费用；以及行政和人员成本。我还预测了将整个340B计划转为返利模式的影响。我预计RMP造成的净收入损失为15亿美元。扩展至整个340B将使预测损失增至228亿美元，使该计划的净收入减少32%。大部分损失将来自行政和人员成本，这些成本并不使制造商受益，这意味着转为返利模式将产生净负面效应。RMP给覆盖实体造成的损失将因试点仅适用于一小部分340B销售以及HRSA指南对制造商施加的限制而有限。如果返利模式扩展至整个340B，或限制执行不到位，损失将大幅增加。
title: How Will the 340B Rebate Model Pilot Affect Covered Entity Finances?
title_zh: 340B返利模式试点将如何影响覆盖实体的财务状况？

abstract: For most of the service sector, market productivity growth has pulled production out of the home. We show that formal nursing care is an exception because its productivity growth has been negative. A two-sector general equilibrium overlapping generations model with informal care attributes the rise in formal care's relative price to this decline, not demography. Care/non-care complementarity dominates formal/informal complementarity. As formal prices rise, elders substitute non-care consumption for formal care, shifting care onto informal caregivers. Population aging need not slow growth if non-care productivity rises or entering cohorts grow and its effects are offset by declining care needs.
abstract_zh: 对于大多数服务业而言，市场生产率增长已将生产从家庭中拉出。我们表明，正规护理是一个例外，因为其生产率增长为负。一个包含非正规护理的两部门一般均衡世代交叠模型将正规护理相对价格的上升归因于这一下降，而非人口结构。护理/非护理之间的互补性主导了正规/非正规之间的互补性。随着正规价格上升，老年人以非护理消费替代正规护理，将护理转移给非正规照护者。如果非护理生产率上升或进入队列增长，且其影响被下降的护理需求所抵消，人口老龄化未必会减缓增长。
title: Aging and Structural Change: Cost Disease in the Care Sector
title_zh: 老龄化与结构变迁：护理部门中的成本病

abstract: Impact measurement is central to impact investing and social entrepreneurship, yet little is known about whether firms benefit privately from measuring impact. We conduct the first randomized controlled trial of an impact measurement intervention among high-growth social enterprises in India. Treated firms exhibit nearly twice as much revenue growth and raise nearly twice as much capital as control firms. In a companion experiment with early-stage investors, we find that investors respond strongly to quantified impact metrics but not to generic qualitative impact statements. Together, our results show that impact measurement can shape firm growth and capital allocation.
abstract_zh: 影响力测量是影响力投资和社会创业的核心，但鲜有人知企业是否能从测量影响力中获得私人收益。我们在印度高成长社会企业中开展了首个影响力测量干预的随机对照试验。处理组企业的收入增长几乎是对照组的两倍，筹集的资本也几乎是对照组的两倍。在一项针对早期阶段投资者的配套实验中，我们发现投资者对量化的影响力指标反应强烈，但对笼统的定性影响力陈述没有反应。总之，我们的结果表明，影响力测量可以塑造企业增长和资本配置。
title: Measuring the Impact of Impact Measurement
title_zh: 衡量影响力测量的影响

abstract: Taxes are harder to enforce on the self-employed than on wage earners, creating horizontal inequities among taxpayers with similar incomes. Using tax microsimulation and household survey data from 29 developing countries, we show that horizontal inequities in actual tax systems are comparable in magnitude to vertical equity and are exacerbated by progressive reforms that fall disproportionately on wage earners. We then conduct surveys and randomized information experiments in Pakistan to study public perceptions of these inequities. Although providing information raises fairness concerns, it does not increase support for reforms reducing it, revealing an important political constraint to improving tax equity.
abstract_zh: 对自雇者征税比工薪收入者更难，从而在收入相近的纳税人之间造成横向不平等。我们使用来自29个发展中国家的税收微观模拟和家庭调查数据表明，实际税制中的横向不平等在量级上与纵向公平相当，并且会因累进改革而加剧，因为这些改革不成比例地落在工薪收入者身上。随后我们在巴基斯坦开展调查和随机信息实验，研究公众对这些不平等的看法。尽管提供信息提高了公平关切，但并未增加对减少不平等的改革的支持，这揭示了改善税收公平的一个重要政治约束。
title: Horizontal Equity of Taxation: Citizen Beliefs and Policy Preferences
title_zh: 税收的横向公平：公民信念与政策偏好

abstract: Using 3,944 sustainable bond issuances by public firms from 2013 to 2022, we examine the causal effect of sustainable investment on governance adoption. A heteroskedasticity-based identification strategy reveals that a 1% increase in sustainable debt (by total debt) raises the likelihood of sustainable governance adoption by 9.2%. Such adoption improves environmental performance by 16% (structural estimates). These effects are confined to non-financial firms; for financial firms, governance adoption alone is in-sufficient, as sustainable loan borrowers environmental performance does not improve. Firms with stronger environmental performance are less likely to adopt sustainable governance. Results are robust to alternative definitions and extensive specification checks.
abstract_zh: 我们使用2013年至2022年间上市公司发行的3,944笔可持续债券，考察可持续投资对治理采纳的因果效应。基于异方差性的识别策略显示，可持续债务（占总债务）每增加1%，采纳可持续治理的可能性提高9.2%。这种采纳使环境绩效提高16%（结构估计）。这些效应仅限于非金融企业；对于金融企业，仅采纳治理是不够的，因为可持续贷款借款人的环境绩效并未改善。环境绩效较强的企业更不可能采纳可持续治理。结果在替代定义和大量设定检验下保持稳健。
title: Investment and Governance: Through The Lens of Sustainability
title_zh: 投资与治理：可持续性视角

abstract: Foreign aid seeks to provide basic services, such as health care and education, to poor and vulnerable populations. Its effectiveness depends on last-mile delivery: whether those services reach the people who need them. This article reviews evidence on two key aspects of last-mile delivery. The first concerns the growing role of non-state providers, especially NGOs, and its implication for state’s capacity to deliver services and coordinate across providers. The second concerns the selection, motivation, and management of frontline workers who provide the services directly to beneficiaries. We argue that decisions about aid allocation and withdrawal should account for the but can quickly erode. need to preserve last-mile delivery capacity, which takes time and resources to build.
abstract_zh: 对外援助旨在为贫困和脆弱人群提供医疗和教育等基本服务。其有效性取决于最后一公里交付：这些服务能否到达需要它们的人手中。本文回顾了关于最后一公里交付两个关键方面的证据。第一个方面涉及非国家提供者（尤其是非政府组织）日益增长的作用，及其对国家提供服务和协调各提供者能力的影响。第二个方面涉及直接向受益人提供服务的一线工作人员的选择、激励和管理。我们认为，关于援助分配和退出的决策应考虑到维护最后一公里交付能力的需要，而这种能力的建设需要时间和资源，但也可能迅速侵蚀。
title: Last-Mile Delivery and the Future of Aid
title_zh: 最后一公里交付与援助的未来

abstract: We use the Phelps-Winter customer market—providing a better theory of price determination for large parts of the economy than the standard model—to show that raising interest rates induces higher prices, as firms value current profits more, and are more willing to lose customers for short-term gains. These inflationary effects can be significant in relevant ranges of interest rates; they exist in the short run even when interest rate hikes succeed in cutting aggregate demand; and that they are amplified by policy uncertainty and the uncertainty about the effects of interest rate changes, both of which have increased as conventional policy has demonstrably failed badly to keep inflation at the 2% target. Empirical studies confirm this low level of ineffectiveness of raising interest rates in reducing inflation. The weakening effectiveness of monetary policy was predicted by our earlier work on banks and the supply of credit, as a result of the elimination of interest prohibition on deposits; and further suggested by work on the structural transformation of the economy, as customer markets become more important.
abstract_zh: 我们使用Phelps-Winter客户市场——它为经济中很大一部分提供了比标准模型更好的价格决定理论——表明提高利率会引发更高价格，因为企业更看重当前利润，并更愿意为短期收益而失去客户。这些通胀效应在相关利率区间内可能很显著；即使加息成功削减总需求，它们在短期内也存在；而且它们会被政策不确定性以及利率变化影响的不确定性放大，而随着常规政策在将通胀保持在2%目标方面明显严重失败，这两种不确定性都已上升。实证研究证实了加息在降低通胀方面处于这种低水平的无效性。货币政策有效性的减弱曾被我们早期关于银行和信贷供给的研究所预测，其原因是存款利息禁令的取消；关于经济结构转型的研究进一步表明，随着客户市场变得更加重要，这一减弱也会出现。
title: Monetary policy in a Phelps–Winter Economy
title_zh: Phelps–Winter经济中的货币政策

abstract: Whether longer exposure to health insurance improves health remains an open empirical question. This study examines the health effects of an additional year of health insurance coverage by exploiting differential changes in coverage pre-to-post implementation of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) for those who were and were not insured prior to the ACA. Using longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study (HRS), we instrument for insurance duration using baseline uninsured status interacted with the post-ACA period. We find that the ACA increased insurance coverage by approximately one additional year among previously uninsured respondents relative to those insured at baseline. Instrumental-variable estimates provide no statistically significant evidence of improvements in self-rated health, depressive symptoms, or hypertension over a four-year follow-up period. These findings are robust across alternative specifications. Overall, results provide little evidence that longer insurance coverage translates into measurable short-term health improvements, while leaving open the possibility of modest or longer-term benefits.
abstract_zh: 更长的医疗保险暴露是否改善健康仍是一个未决的实证问题。本研究利用《平价医疗法案》（ACA）实施前后，对ACA之前已参保和未参保者保险覆盖率的差异变化，考察额外一年医疗保险覆盖的健康效应。使用《健康与退休研究》（HRS）的纵向数据，我们以基线未参保状态与ACA后时期的交互项作为保险持续时间的工具变量。我们发现，相对于基线已参保的受访者，ACA使先前未参保受访者的保险覆盖增加了约一年。工具变量估计在四年随访期内未提供自评健康、抑郁症状或高血压改善的统计显著证据。这些发现在替代设定下稳健。总体而言，结果几乎没有证据表明更长的保险覆盖转化为可测量的短期健康改善，同时保留了 modest 或长期益处的可能性。
title: The Effects of Years of Health Insurance on the Health of Older Adults
title_zh: 医疗保险年限对老年人健康的影响

abstract: Neoclassical demand obeys regularity: adding a good can only draw demand away from existing goods. In a natural field experiment with Lyft covering 7.2 million riders and 47 million choices, we randomize the presence and price of a premium ride. Contrary to regularity, the premium ride raises demand for the cheapest incumbent and for not buying. The effect grows with the premium price and with repeated exposure, and persists in sessions where the premium ride is not displayed. Rational inference and inattention cannot account for these facts. A model in which a surprisingly high price, cued on the app and retrieved from memory, draws attention to prices explains them.
abstract_zh: 新古典需求遵循正则性：增加一种商品只能将需求从现有商品上引开。在一项覆盖720万乘客和4700万次选择的Lyft自然实地实验中，我们随机化高端乘车的存在和价格。与正则性相反，高端乘车提高了对最便宜现有选项和不购买的需求。该效应随高端价格和重复暴露而增大，并在未展示高端乘车的会话中持续存在。理性推断和注意力不足无法解释这些事实。一个模型可以解释这些现象：令人意外的高价格在应用上被提示并从记忆中提取，从而将注意力引向价格。
title: Irregular Demand: The Anti-Compromise Effect in the Field
title_zh: 不规则需求：实地中的反妥协效应

abstract: In 2019, about 1.2 million foreign workers were employed through temporary high-skill programs, including H-1B and OPT. This paper identifies likely temporary workers in the American Community Survey and measures their supply by education and field of degree. Natives in the most exposed skill groups experienced slower earnings growth and a relative decline in full-time year-round work. Many temporary workers stay after their status ends, but surveys cannot identify these stayers. A model of temporary inflows and stayers shows that, under specified conditions, the coefficient from an IV regression of native outcomes on the number of current temporary workers embodies a stayer multiplier, capturing the effects of both those workers and earlier stayers. Multiplying the coefficient by the observed increase in temporary workers recovers the programs’ full effect without data on stayers. The estimates imply that natives with science and engineering degrees earn about 3.5 percent less, and those with master’s degrees in computing or electrical and computer engineering about 16 percent less. Production complementarities raise average wages by about 1.4 percent, offsetting only part of those losses. Absent externalities, the programs mainly redistribute earnings.
abstract_zh: 2019年，约120万外国工人通过临时高技能项目就业，包括H-1B和OPT。本文在美国社区调查中识别可能的临时工人，并按教育程度和学位领域衡量其供给。暴露程度最高的技能组中的本土人经历了更慢的收入增长和全职全年工作的相对下降。许多临时工人在身份结束后留下，但调查无法识别这些留下者。一个关于临时流入和留下者的模型表明，在特定条件下，将本土结果对当前临时工人数量进行IV回归所得的系数体现了一个留下者乘数，捕捉了这些工人和更早留下者的效应。将系数乘以观察到的临时工人增加量，可在没有留下者数据的情况下恢复项目的全部效应。估计结果表明，拥有科学和工程学位的本土人收入约低3.5%，拥有计算或电气与计算机工程硕士学位的本土人收入约低16%。生产互补性使平均工资提高约1.4%，仅抵消了这些损失的一部分。在没有外部性的情况下，这些项目主要重新分配收入。
title: The Labor Market Impact of Temporary High-Skill Immigration Programs
title_zh: 临时高技能移民项目的劳动力市场影响

abstract: One of the most notable developments in U.S. electoral politics over the last 40 years is the increasing divide between men and women voters. While men and women had roughly equivalent levels of support for both the Democratic and Republican parties in 1980, more recent surveys have revealed a roughly 10 to 15-percentage-point gap in preference for the Democratic party among women relative to men. We explain this result by using a variety of econometric strategies to establish a novel connection between compulsory schooling laws (CSLs), educational attainment, and diverging political preferences by sex. First, we show that the timing of this divergence is coincident with recent changes in CSLs, and that this divergence is almost entirely due to changes in sex-related preferences for the Democratic party in states where there exists a much stronger effect of CSLs on average educational attainment -- very little change in sex-related preferences for the Democratic party is present in other states. Furthermore, in states with more-impactful CSLs, changes in CSLs and their associated increased educational attainment explain almost all of the diverging support for political parties and differences in opinion over major policy issues by sex, such as gun control and abortion. Altogether, these new facts present an original explanation that relies upon the effect of education to explain the evolution of gender political preferences in the U.S. over the last 40 years.
abstract_zh: 过去40年美国选举政治最显著的发展之一是男性和女性选民之间日益扩大的分歧。1980年，男性和女性对民主党和共和党的支持水平大致相当，而更近期的调查显示，女性相对于男性对民主党的偏好存在约10至15个百分点的差距。我们通过使用多种计量经济学策略，建立义务教育法（CSLs）、教育 attainment 与按性别分化的政治偏好之间的新颖联系，来解释这一结果。首先，我们表明这一分歧的时间与近期CSLs的变化相吻合，并且这一分歧几乎完全归因于在CSLs对平均教育 attainment 影响强得多的州中，对民主党偏好的性别相关变化——在其他州，对民主党的性别相关偏好几乎没有变化。此外，在CSLs影响更大的州，CSLs的变化及其相关的教育 attainment 提高几乎解释了按性别分化的政党支持以及枪支管制和堕胎等重大政策议题意见差异的全部。总之，这些新事实提出了一个依赖教育效应来解释过去40年美国性别政治偏好演变的原创性解释。
title: Education and Gender Voting Polarization: The Effect of Compulsory Schooling on Sex-Based Preferences for the Democratic and Republican Parties
title_zh: 教育与性别投票极化：义务教育法对民主党和共和党性别偏好的影响

abstract: We derive an aggregate state-space representation of state-dependent pricing models with random menu costs and strategic complementarities. The representation, derived from first principles, replaces the cross-sectional distribution of price gaps with a finite set of its moments (the first three), while preserving the key economic forces of state-dependent pricing--movements in the frequency of price adjustment and selection. Along the impulse response, inflation is an odd (cubic) polynomial in the average price gap. Embedded in a general equilibrium setting, the model can be solved by perturbation, filtered, and estimated with standard DSGE tools, and it matches well the global solution across shock sizes. Applied to the 2021--22 inflation surge in the United States and the euro area, it shows that much of the variation that linear models would attribute to cost-push shocks is in fact endogenous amplification through the frequency of price changes and selection.
abstract_zh: 我们推导了具有随机菜单成本和战略互补性的状态依存定价模型的加总状态空间表示。该表示从第一性原理推导而来，用价格缺口的有限个矩（前三个）替代其横截面分布，同时保留状态依存定价的关键经济力量——价格调整频率的变动和选择效应。沿脉冲响应，通胀是平均价格缺口的奇次（三次）多项式。嵌入一般均衡环境后，该模型可以通过扰动法求解、滤波，并用标准DSGE工具估计，且在不同冲击规模下与全局解吻合良好。应用于2021–22年美国及欧元区的通胀飙升，结果表明，线性模型会归因于成本推动冲击的很大一部分变异，实际上是通过价格变化频率和选择效应产生的内生放大。
title: An Odd Approximation of Inflation for State Dependent Pricing Models
title_zh: 状态依存定价模型的一种通胀奇次近似

abstract: In the United States, for nuclear power to contribute meaningfully to future clean-energy portfolios, new plant construction must achieve cost competitiveness and demonstrate reduced risk of cost and schedule overruns—factors that directly influence federal and state energy policy, utility investment decisions, and public acceptance. Within this policy landscape, the structure of project delivery and the allocation of risk across participating firms are not merely technical construction considerations—they are central determinants of whether nuclear projects can satisfy the financial, regulatory, and societal criteria required for approval and long-term operation. Understanding how delivery models perform is therefore critical to shaping effective energy policy mechanisms, such as cost-recovery frameworks, loan-guarantee programs, risk-sharing incentives, and procurement standards. This study quantitatively analyzes historical U.S. nuclear construction data, focusing on cost and schedule overruns and the performance implications of how responsibilities were distributed among project participants. Predictor variables were introduced to contextualize the results within broader policy-relevant conditions, including regulatory uncertainty and project complexity. The findings indicate that contracting models involving 2 major actors (the most common of which is an Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) contracting model) have historically exhibited improved performance compared to other contracting approaches. Projects where the Owner also performed EPC responsibilities, or where Owner, Engineering and Construction roles were all within separate firms, exhibited higher schedule overruns. This conclusion was present when controlling for the influence of geographic region, reactor design and construction date. From an energy policy perspective, this suggests that Project Delivery System (PDS) choices can affect the financial risk profile of nuclear development and, by extension, the policy tools required to support it. Strengthening these delivery mechanisms should be considered a priority within broader policy strategies aimed at enabling a reliable, affordable, and politically durable nuclear renaissance in the United States.
abstract_zh: 在美国，要使核 power 为未来清洁能源组合做出有意义的贡献，新建电厂必须实现成本竞争力，并证明成本和进度超支风险降低——这些因素直接影响联邦和州能源政策、公用事业投资决策和公众接受度。在这一政策背景下，项目交付结构以及参与企业之间的风险分配不仅是技术性建设考量，更是决定核项目能否满足获批和长期运行所需的财务、监管和社会标准的核心因素。因此，理解交付模型的表现对于塑造有效的能源政策机制至关重要，例如成本回收框架、贷款担保计划、风险分担激励和采购标准。本研究定量分析美国核建设历史数据，重点关注成本和进度超支，以及项目参与方之间责任分配方式对绩效的影响。引入预测变量，以将结果置于更广泛的政策相关条件中，包括监管不确定性和项目复杂性。研究结果表明，涉及2个主要参与方的 contracting 模型（其中最常见的是 Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) contracting 模型）在历史上相比其他 contracting 方式表现出更好的绩效。由 Owner 同时承担 EPC 责任，或 Owner、Engineering 和 Construction 角色分属不同公司的项目，表现出更高的进度超支。在控制地理区域、反应堆设计和建设日期的影响时，这一结论仍然成立。从能源政策角度看，这表明 Project Delivery System (PDS) 选择会影响核开发的财务风险状况，并进而影响支持其发展所需的政策工具。在旨在促成美国可靠、可负担且政治上持久的核复兴的更广泛政策战略中，加强这些交付机制应被视为优先事项。
title: Relationship between project delivery system and historic nuclear power plant construction performance in the United States
title_zh: 项目交付系统与美国历史核电厂建设绩效之间的关系

abstract: An increasing number of central banks have begun disclosing reserve currency shares. This column introduces a new public database providing information on the reserve currency composition of 149 countries across 23 currencies, covering the period 1999 to 2026, which allows a granular analysis of the factors driving reserve currency composition. Liquidity, return, and safety are the determinants most frequently cited when explaining allocation decisions. While central banks rarely acknowledge it publicly, a growing body of evidence also suggests a role for geopolitical considerations and international alliances.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的央行开始披露储备货币份额。本专栏介绍一个新的公共数据库，提供1999年至2026年期间149个国家23种货币的储备货币构成信息，从而能够对驱动储备货币构成的因素进行细粒度分析。在解释配置决策时，流动性、回报和安全性是最常被提及的决定因素。尽管央行很少公开承认，但越来越多的证据还表明地缘政治考量和国际联盟也发挥作用。
title: Inside central banks’ currency portfolios: New evidence from 149 countries and 23 currencies
title_zh: 央行货币组合内幕：来自149个国家和23种货币的新证据

abstract: Senders now have more ways than ever to move money across borders, yet costs remain high and vary widely across corridors. This column argues that a missing piece in explaining these high costs is the exchange rate risk borne by the intermediaries that move the currency, the money transfer operators. Across 339 remittance corridors worldwide, fees rise when the recipient country’s currency becomes more volatile, and this currency risk adds about as much to the price of a transfer as operators’ markups. Competition alone cannot lower these costs.
abstract_zh: 如今，汇款人有比以往更多的方式跨境转移资金，但成本依然高昂，且各走廊之间差异巨大。本文认为，解释这些高成本的一个缺失环节是转移货币的中介机构——汇款运营商所承担的汇率风险。在全球339条汇款走廊中，当收款国货币变得更加波动时，费用就会上升，而这种货币风险给转账价格带来的增加，大致相当于运营商的加价。仅靠竞争无法降低这些成本。
title: Currency risk drives remittance fees as much as markups do
title_zh: 货币风险与加价一样驱动汇款费用

abstract: Whether inflation can ease public debt burdens is an increasingly important question as debt sustainability concerns rise in the euro area. This column applies a new debt decomposition framework to assess how inflation affected debt ratios in the five largest euro area sovereign issuers over 2005–2025. It finds that inflation played a small role in reducing the public debt burden. The post-pandemic inflation surprise largely reflected imported costs, which do little to raise nominal output. Increases in longer-term inflation compensation lowered the market value of debt, but were not sufficient to offset the debt-increasing effect of earlier declines.
abstract_zh: 随着欧元区债务可持续性担忧加剧，通胀能否缓解公共债务负担成为日益重要的问题。本专栏应用新的债务分解框架，评估2005—2025年间通胀如何影响欧元区五大主权发行国的债务比率。研究发现，通胀在减轻公共债务负担方面作用有限。疫情后的通胀意外主要反映输入性成本，而输入性成本对提高名义产出作用甚微。较长期通胀补偿的上升降低了债务的市场价值，但不足以抵消早前下降带来的债务增加效应。
authors: Jef Boeckx, Leonardo Iania, Joris Wauters
title: The effects of inflation on euro area public debt
title_zh: 通货膨胀对欧元区公共债务的影响

abstract: This paper estimates the short-run effect of government health and education expenditures—often classified as merit goods—on output in developing countries. A novel instrument is constructed to identify the fiscal multiplier, exploiting two features of the budget process and electoral environment: (1) approved budget allocations are legislated before the fiscal year begins and, given the multi-year nature of health and education programs, reflect planning decisions taken well in advance of contemporaneous output shocks, and (2) constitutionally predetermined electoral timing generates political incentives for incumbents to increase and accelerate the execution of planned budgets in visible sectors like health and education ahead of elections. The instrument therefore interacts budget allocations with electoral cycle timing to isolate the predetermined, electorally driven component of merit goods spending. The estimated multiplier is around 2. Multipliers are larger in recessions, supporting health and education spending as effective countercyclical fiscal tools. Furthermore, multipliers are larger where shares of merit goods spending in output are low, which reflects stronger stimulative effects where unmet needs are greatest. Additionally, better institutions, proxied by control of corruption, condition the size of the multiplier. These findings suggest that health and education spending can yield a dual dividend, boosting economic activity even before their well-known longer-term productivity gains of a healthier, more educated population materialize.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了政府卫生与教育支出——通常被归类为优效品——对发展中国家产出的短期效应。本文构建了一种新的工具变量来识别财政乘数，利用预算过程与选举环境的两个特征：(1) 获批的预算拨款在财政年度开始前即已立法确定，且鉴于卫生与教育项目的多年度性质，其反映了远早于同期产出冲击所作出的规划决策；(2) 宪法预先确定的选举时机构成了政治激励，促使现任者在选举前增加并加快卫生和教育等可见部门既定预算的执行。因此，该工具变量将预算拨款与选举周期时点进行交互，以分离出优效品支出中预先确定的、由选举驱动的成分。估计的乘数约为2。乘数在衰退期更大，支持将卫生与教育支出作为有效的逆周期财政工具。此外，在优效品支出占产出份额较低的地方乘数更大，这反映出在未满足需求最大之处刺激效应更强。另外，以腐败控制为代理变量的更优制度会调节乘数的大小。这些发现表明，卫生与教育支出能够产生双重红利，甚至在其众所周知的、更健康且受教育程度更高的人口所带来的长期生产率收益实现之前，就能提振经济活动。

title: Fiscal Multipliers of Government Health and Education Expenditures: Evidence from Electoral Budget Cycles
title_zh: 政府卫生与教育支出的财政乘数：来自选举预算周期的证据

abstract: Traditional valuation metrics for the U.S. stock market based on a comparison of the aggregate market value of U.S. corporations to measures of dividends, earnings, output, and the replacement cost of measured capital have been above historical norms for 25{30 years. Will they return to their historical means? We use macroe- conomic data to argue that the observed decline in labor's share of corporate output in conjunction with relatively weak corporate investment mechanically generates a persistent decline in the ra- tio of corporate earnings to corporate valuation, even absent any changes in expected returns or growth rates.
abstract_zh: 基于美国企业总市值与股息、收益、产出及已计量资本的重置成本之比的传统美国股市估值指标，在过去25至30年间一直高于历史常态。它们会回归历史均值吗？我们运用宏观经济数据论证，观察到的劳动在企业产出中所占份额下降，加之企业投资相对疲弱，即便在预期回报或增长率没有任何变化的情况下，也会机械地导致企业收益与企业估值之比持续下降。
title: A Macroeconomic Perspective on Stock Market Valuation Ratios
title_zh: 股市估值比率的宏观经济学视角

abstract: Electricity reliability is a central challenge for the energy transition, as growing energy demand, renewable energy integration, and natural disasters increase the risk of large-scale blackouts. However, the economic impacts of large-scale blackouts remain largely unknown. Combining electricity market data with high-frequency economic transaction data from Chile, we find that economic activity declined by 34.4 percent on the nationwide blackout day, but nearly half of this loss was recovered on subsequent days, highlighting the importance of intertemporal substitution. Exploiting spatial variation in blackouts, we show that accounting for endogenous recovery is critical when estimating the marginal value of lost load.
abstract_zh: 电力可靠性是能源转型的核心挑战，因为不断增长的能源需求、可再生能源并网以及自然灾害都增加了大规模停电的风险。然而，大规模停电的经济影响在很大程度上仍然未知。结合电力市场数据与来自智利的高频经济交易数据，我们发现，在全国性停电当天，经济活动下降了34.4%，但这一损失中近一半在随后几天得到恢复，凸显了跨期替代的重要性。利用停电的空间差异，我们表明，在估计失负荷边际价值时，考虑内生性恢复至关重要。
title: Zero Energy Day: How Nationwide Blackouts Affect the Economy*
title_zh: 零能源日：全国性停电如何影响经济

abstract: Using U.S. administrative data on worker earnings, we show that increases in risk premia lead to lower labor earnings, particularly for lower-paid workers. These declines are primarily driven by job separations. We build an equilibrium model of labor market search that quantitatively replicates the observed heterogeneity in labor market dynamics across worker earnings levels. Our findings underscore the role of time-varying risk premia as a key driver of labor market fluctuations and highlight the importance of both the job creation and the job destruction margins in understanding the heterogeneity in worker outcomes over the business cycle.
abstract_zh: 利用美国劳动者收入的行政数据，我们表明风险溢价的上升会导致劳动收入下降，尤其是对低薪劳动者而言。这些下降主要由工作岗位分离驱动。我们构建了一个劳动力市场搜寻的均衡模型，该模型在数量上复现了不同劳动者收入水平下劳动力市场动态的观察异质性。我们的发现强调了时变风险溢价作为劳动力市场波动关键驱动因素的作用，并突出了岗位创造和岗位破坏边际在理解经济周期中劳动者结果异质性的重要性。
title: Time-Varying Risk Premia and Heterogeneous Labor Market Dynamics
title_zh: 时变风险溢价与异质性劳动力市场动态

abstract: Transparency is a basic requirement of government accountability, allowing citizens to access the information necessary to monitor, reward, and punish politicians and bureaucrats. We show that reelection incentives affect transparency by comparing the responsiveness of MuckRock freedom-of-information requests filed just before state and municipal elections to identical requests filed elsewhere at the same time. Holding timing, submitter, and content fixed, we find that our measure of “revealed transparency” is lower ahead of elections in more corrupt states and cities. These results suggest that discretion is used to limit access to information relevant to political accountability.
abstract_zh: 透明度是政府问责的基本要求，使公民能够获取监督、奖励和惩罚政治人物与官僚所需的信息。我们通过比较在州和地方选举前夕提交的MuckRock信息自由请求与同一时间在其他地方提交的相同请求的响应性，表明连任激励会影响透明度。在时间、提交者和内容固定的情况下，我们发现，在腐败程度更高的州和城市，选举前我们衡量的“显示透明度”更低。这些结果表明，自由裁量权被用来限制获取与政治问责相关的信息。
title: Electoral Incentives and Government Transparency: Evidence from Freedom of Information Requests
title_zh: 选举激励与政府透明度：来自信息自由请求的证据

abstract: This paper investigates the causal effects of immigrant labor mobility frictions on firm monopsony and entrepreneurship. An unexpected information-technology change to the green card process reduced inter-firm mobility for Indian and Chinese immigrants in October 2005. Firms leveraged their increased monopsony power to reduce internal promotions for Indian and Chinese employees and boost profitability. Meanwhile, startups were disproportionately impacted, experiencing twice the decline in worker mobility compared to incumbents, constraining new firm formation. These findings highlight how immigration-related labor mobility frictions can shape firm dynamics by benefiting established firms and hindering new firm formation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究移民劳动力流动摩擦对企业买方垄断和创业的因果效应。2005年10月，绿卡流程中一项意外的信息技术变革降低了印度和中国移民在企业间的流动性。企业利用其增强的买方垄断力量，减少了对印度和中国员工的内部晋升，并提高了盈利能力。与此同时，初创企业受到不成比例的影响，其员工流动性下降幅度是现有企业的两倍，从而制约了新企业的形成。这些发现凸显了与移民相关的劳动力流动摩擦如何通过有利于现有企业、阻碍新企业形成来塑造企业动态。

title: Labor Mobility, Firm Monopsony, and Entrepreneurship: Evidence from Immigration Wait-Lines
title_zh: 劳动力流动、企业买方垄断与创业：来自移民等候线的证据

abstract: We develop a dynamic model of technology adoption featuring strategic complementarities: the benefits of the technology increase with the number of adopters. We show that complementarities give rise to gradual adoption, multiple equilibria, multiple steady states, and suboptimal allocations. We study the planner’s problem and its implementation through adoption subsidies. We apply the theory to SINPE Móvil, a peer-to-peer payment app developed by the Central Bank of Costa Rica. Using transaction-level data and user-specific networks that we construct from administrative records, we causally estimate sizable complementarities. In our calibrated model, the optimal subsidy pushes the economy to universal adoption.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含策略互补性的技术采纳动态模型：技术的收益随着采纳者数量的增加而增加。我们表明，互补性会导致渐进式采纳、多重均衡、多重稳态以及次优配置。我们研究了规划者问题及其通过采纳补贴的实施。我们将该理论应用于SINPE Móvil——由哥斯达黎加中央银行开发的一款点对点支付应用。利用交易层面数据以及我们从行政记录中构建的用户特定网络，我们因果性地估计出显著的互补性。在我们校准的模型中，最优补贴推动经济实现全民采纳。
title: Strategic Complementarities in a Dynamic Model of Technology Adoption: P2P Digital Payments
title_zh: 技术采纳动态模型中的策略互补性：P2P数字支付

abstract: We study reporting responses to the contribution-benefit link in the context of parental benefits in Hungary and Latvia. Earnings and employment patterns show pre-pregnancy under-reporting followed by partial formalization. During pregnancy, the share of Hungarian women reporting the minimum wage falls from 35% to 26%, and 15% start reporting exactly twice the minimum wage, the benefit-maximizing threshold. At small firms, earnings rise 5% in Hungary and 21% in Latvia during pregnancy, and the magnitude of the response tracks changing incentives. Linking benefits to contributions when earnings are under-reported reduces evasion but can impose net fiscal costs depending on program design.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在匈牙利和拉脱维亚父母福利背景下，缴费与受益关联所引发的申报反应。收入与就业模式显示，孕前存在低报现象，随后出现部分正规化。在孕期，匈牙利女性申报最低工资的比例从35%降至26%，另有15%开始恰好申报最低工资的两倍，即福利最大化门槛。在小企业，匈牙利孕期收入上升5%，拉脱维亚上升21%，且反应幅度与激励变化相吻合。在收入被低报的情况下将福利与缴费挂钩可减少逃避行为，但视项目设计而定，可能带来净财政成本。
title: Tax Evasion and the Contribution-Benefit Link: The Case of Parental Benefits in Hungary and Latvia
title_zh: 逃税与缴费-受益关联：匈牙利和拉脱维亚的父母福利案例

abstract: This paper documents the downstream enforcement spillovers in the value-added tax (VAT) system. We study a tax reform in China that stops agro-processing firms from issuing fraudulent, self-billed invoices. The reform increases VAT payments from targeted firms by 20.8%. More importantly, this upstream crackdown on fake invoices generates powerful downstream effects: agro-processing firms’ clients raise VAT payments by 18.1%; and agro-processing exporters claim 53.1% less in export refunds. Totaling 108% of the direct effect, these newly identified downward spillovers demonstrate that upstream enforcement can powerfully cascade through the production chain in the VAT system with minimal economic distortion.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了增值税（VAT）体系中的下游执法溢出效应。我们研究了中国的一项税制改革，该改革阻止农产品加工企业开具虚假的自开发票。改革使目标企业的增值税缴纳额增加了20.8%。更重要的是，这场针对虚假发票的上游打击产生了强有力的下游效应：农产品加工企业的客户增值税缴纳额增加了18.1%；农产品加工出口企业申请的出口退税减少了53.1%。这些新识别的向下溢出效应合计达到直接效应的108%，表明上游执法能够在增值税体系中以最小的经济扭曲沿生产链强力级联传导。

title: Downstream Spillovers in Value Added Tax Enforcement: Evidence from China
title_zh: 增值税执法中的下游溢出效应：来自中国的证据

abstract: Governments often deploy multiple policy instruments toward a shared goal, yet their impacts are typically studied in isolation. We examine two geographically targeted efforts to reduce Medicare-financed home health services—strike-force prosecutions for suspected fraud and moratoria on new agency entry. Locations experienced either both, one, or neither policy. Individually, each policy substantially reduced home health use and was well targeted to places with larger treatment effects. Although we estimate only modest interaction between the two policies, optimally allocating them across treated areas could have raised the total impact by roughly 20%. Our exercise underscores the value of policy coordination.
abstract_zh: 政府常为实现共同目标而部署多种政策工具，但这些工具的影响通常被孤立研究。我们考察了两项以地理为靶向、旨在减少由Medicare资助的家庭健康服务的举措——针对疑似欺诈的突击起诉和对新机构准入的暂停令。各地或同时经历两项政策，或仅经历其中一项，或均未经历。单独来看，每项政策都大幅减少了家庭健康服务使用量，并且很好地瞄准了处理效应更大的地区。尽管我们估计两项政策之间的交互作用仅为温和，但在受处理地区之间优化配置这些政策本可使总影响提高约20%。我们的分析凸显了政策协调的价值。
title: Overlapping Policy Interventions: Evidence from Home Health
title_zh: 重叠政策干预：来自家庭健康护理的证据

abstract: We characterize optimal monetary policy under state-dependent pricing. The framework gives rise to nonlinear inflation dynamics: large inflationary shocks trigger more frequent price adjustments, making the price level more flexible. Following large cost-push shocks, the central bank exploits this increased flexibility and curbs inflation more aggressively and at a lower output cost than in standard time-dependent models. The optimal policy is well approximated by a nonlinear Taylor rule, in which the anti-inflationary stance increases more than proportionally with inflation. When faced with a total factor productivity shock—a shock to efficient output—the optimal policy maintains strict price stability.
abstract_zh: 我们刻画了状态依存定价下的最优货币政策。该框架产生了非线性的通胀动态：较大的通胀冲击会触发更频繁的价格调整，使价格水平更具灵活性。在较大的成本推动冲击之后，中央银行利用这种增强的灵活性，以比标准时间依存模型更激进的方式抑制通胀，且产出成本更低。最优政策可由非线性泰勒规则很好地近似，其中反通胀立场随通胀超比例增强。当面临全要素生产率冲击——即对有效产出的冲击——时，最优政策保持严格的价格稳定。
title: Strike while the Iron is Hot: Optimal Monetary Policy under State-Dependent Pricing
title_zh: 趁热打铁：状态依存定价下的最优货币政策

abstract: I develop a tractable dynamic sticky-price model, where input-output linkages are formed endogenously. The model delivers cyclical properties of networks that are consistent with those I estimate using sectoral and firm-level data, conditional on identified real and nominal shocks. A novel source of state dependence in nominal rigidities arises: the strength of complementarities in price setting and monetary non-neutrality increase in the number of suppliers optimally chosen by firms. As a result, the model simultaneously rationalizes the following observed non-linearities in monetary transmission: cycle dependence, path dependence and size dependence.
abstract_zh: 我构建了一个易于处理的动态粘性价格模型，其中投入产出联系是内生形成的。该模型所给出的网络周期性特征，与我在已识别的实际冲击和名义冲击条件下、使用部门层面和企业层面数据估计出的特征相一致。名义刚性中出现了一种新的状态依赖来源：价格设定中的互补性强度以及货币非中性程度，会随着企业最优选择的供应商数量增加而上升。因此，该模型同时解释了货币传导中观察到的以下非线性特征：周期依赖、路径依赖和规模依赖。
title: Endogenous Production Networks and Non-Linear Monetary Transmission
title_zh: 内生生产网络与非线性货币政策传导

abstract: How do immigration restrictions affect the wages of low-skilled workers? We study the 1920s U.S. national-origins quotas, which abruptly and unevenly curtailed immigration from key source countries, generating sharp labor-supply shocks across local markets. Using newly digitized annual wage data for low-skilled laborers from 1910–1929, we show that wages rose faster in markets more dependent on restricted-origin immigrants, with effects emerging soon after 1920, intensifying through the mid-1920s, and persisting over time. Evidence on wage dynamics and mechanisms indicates that these gains reflect sustained labor scarcity rather than mechanical compositional changes.
abstract_zh: 移民限制如何影响低技能工人的工资？我们研究了20世纪20年代美国原籍国配额制度，该制度突然且不均衡地限制了主要来源国的移民，在各地方劳动力市场造成了急剧的劳动力供给冲击。利用新近数字化的1910—1929年低技能劳动者年度工资数据，我们表明，在更依赖受限原籍移民的市场中，工资上涨更快，其效应在1920年后不久显现，并在20世纪20年代中期加剧，且随时间持续存在。关于工资动态和机制的证据表明，这些工资增长反映的是持续的劳动力稀缺，而非机械性的构成变化。
title: Immigration Restrictions and the Wages of Low-Skilled Labor: Evidence from the 1920s
title_zh: 移民限制与低技能劳动力的工资：来自20世纪20年代的证据

abstract: When do institutional reforms generate durable independence, and what trade-offs follow? We study a reform in Pakistan that shifted control over a key state appointment process away from the executive and toward a professional committee. The reform triggered a self-reinforcing cycle of institutional independence, but also increased elite concentration: new entrants came disproportionately from a small network of high-status professional firms. Despite this narrower pipeline, we document improvements in decision quality and a higher share of appointments from top law schools. These findings suggest that institutional reforms can deepen rule of law, even when they select from a narrower pool.
abstract_zh: 制度性改革何时能产生持久的独立性，又会带来哪些权衡？我们研究巴基斯坦的一项改革，该改革将一项关键国家任命程序的控制权从行政部门转向一个专业委员会。这项改革引发了制度独立性的自我强化循环，但也加剧了精英集中：新进入者不成比例地来自一个由高地位专业事务所组成的小型网络。尽管输送管道更为狭窄，我们记录了决策质量的改善以及来自顶尖法学院任命比例的上升。这些发现表明，制度性改革即便从更狭窄的人才池中选拔，也能深化法治。
title: When Institutions Persist: Judicial Independence in an Unstable Political Order
title_zh: 当制度存续：不稳定政治秩序中的司法独立

abstract: Speculative booms are vulnerable to shifts in risk perceptions, which can generate demand recessions. In a model where investors’ heterogeneous asset valuations spur speculation, we study whether monetary policy should lean against booms, lowering asset prices to reduce this vulnerability. Optimal policy leans and thereby mitigates recessions, even when leaning is unexpected and surprises investors. This policy backloads hikes and steepens the yield curve during booms, with asset prices declining gradually, not sharply. In contrast, front-loaded leaning can erode investors’ wealth, depress demand for risky assets, and deepen downturns (“sow the wind”). Our results apply in low-interest-rate environments.
abstract_zh: 投机性繁荣易受风险认知变化的影响，这种变化可能引发需求衰退。在一个投资者对资产估值异质性驱动投机的模型中，我们研究货币政策是否应逆风而行，通过降低资产价格来减少这种脆弱性。最优政策会逆风而行，从而缓解衰退，即使逆风而行出乎意料并令投资者感到意外。该政策在繁荣期将加息后置并使收益率曲线陡峭化，资产价格逐渐下降，而非急剧下跌。相反，前置式逆风而行可能侵蚀投资者财富，抑制对风险资产的需求，并加深衰退（“播种风”）。我们的结果适用于低利率环境。
title: Leaning without Sowing the Wind: Optimal Monetary Policy in Speculative Booms
title_zh: 未雨绸缪：投机繁荣中的最优货币政策

abstract: We document a technological change in production technology biased towards intangible capital, such as computerized information and software, over other inputs in the last three decades. This has led to higher investment adjustment costs for firms. A general equilibrium firm dynamics model suggests that this can result in (i) increased firm size and concentration, (ii) changes in aggregate factor shares, and (iii) rise in dispersion of total factor productivity revenue coupled with declining aggregate productivity. This paper provides an alternative mechanism behind these macroeconomic changes in the US economy, emphasizing the efficient response of firms to changes in production technology.
title: The Rise of Intangible Capital and the Macroeconomic Implications
title_zh: 无形资本的崛起及其宏观经济影响

abstract: Fiscal stimulus policies propagate through complex and overlapping economic networks. We study their efficacy and targeting in the presence of input-output linkages, regional trade, and household heterogeneity in employment relationships, marginal propensities to consume (MPCs), and consumption baskets. Theoretically, we derive estimable formulae for fiscal multipliers and characterize how network structures determine their size. Empirically, we estimate that multipliers vary substantially across policies, so targeting is important. However, virtually all variation in multipliers stems from differences in policies’ direct incidence onto households’ MPCs. Thus, while policies’ distributional effects depend on network structures, maximally expansionary fiscal policy simply targets households’ MPCs.
title: Fiscal Policy in a Networked Economy
title_zh: 网络化经济中的财政政策

abstract: Countries with higher levels of human capital are often more technologically advanced. We study whether formally modeling the importance of human capital for technology adoption decisions can amplify the importance of the former in accounting for cross-country income differences. We document new evidence suggesting that education and technology use are complements in generating income. We develop a general equilibrium model featuring human capital investment, endogenous occupational choices, and technology adoption. Economies differ in terms of schooling and barriers to technology adoption. These differences together generate a ninefold income gap between the US and the poorest quartile of countries.
title: Cross-country Income Dispersion, Human Capital, and Technology Adoption
title_zh: 跨国收入离散度、人力资本与技术采纳

abstract: This paper examines how the emergence of conservative talk radio following the 1988 national syndication of The Rush Limbaugh Show shaped U.S. political behavior. The research design exploits spatial variation in programming competition and commuting time, which jointly predict individual political talk radio consumption, together with the abrupt nationwide expansion of the medium. Republican vote share increased disproportionately in high-exposure counties after 1988. Analysis of campaign contributions reveals similarly patterned increases in donations to Republican candidates, driven by male donors. These findings suggest that partisan media may have contributed to political divergence across geographic areas and between men and women.
title: The Political Legacy of Conservative Talk Radio
title_zh: 保守派脱口秀电台的政治遗产

abstract: Young adults in advanced economies have grown more pessimistic about their economic prospects in recent years. At the same time, gambling-like financial activities have proliferated. We link these trends through a Friedman-Savage (1948) motive: when life goals such as homeownership or marriage seem out of reach, individuals turn to financial gambles. We test this theory using an original survey combined with millions of linked records from Korea’s leading credit bureau, telecom provider, and credit card issuer. Consistent with the theory, individuals who place greater importance on hard-to-reach goals take more risk, and the form of risk they take varies systematically with their distance from those goals. Within individuals, cryptocurrency app usage rises during unemployment and falls after winning the right to purchase price-regulated housing through a lottery. A calibration shows how hard-to-reach goals lead households to act more aggressively on their beliefs, amplifying the consequences of overoptimism.
abstract_zh: 近年来，发达经济体的年轻人对其经济前景变得更加悲观。与此同时，类似赌博的金融活动激增。我们通过Friedman-Savage（1948）动机将这两种趋势联系起来：当购房或结婚等人生目标似乎遥不可及时，个人会转向金融赌博。我们使用一项原创调查，并结合来自韩国领先征信机构、电信提供商和信用卡发行商的数百万条关联记录来检验这一理论。与该理论一致，更重视难以实现目标的个人承担更多风险，而且他们承担风险的形式随其与这些目标的距离而系统性变化。在个体内部，加密货币应用使用率在失业期间上升，而在通过抽签赢得购买价格管制住房的权利后下降。一项校准展示了难以实现的目标如何导致家庭更激进地依据其信念行事，从而放大过度乐观的后果。
title: Gambling for Goals
title_zh: 为人生目标而赌博
